Shōgoi, under the [[:en:Ritsuryō|Ritsuryō system]], was divided into upper and lower grades. In terms of {{ill|official Ranks|ja|官位|1=Kan'i system|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/official Ranks|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan'i system|qq=}}, it corresponded primarily to {{ill|Kyōkan|ja|京官|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kyōkan|qq=}} (capitals officers), especially positions such as {{ill|Benkan|ja|弁官|1=Benkan (administrator)|lt=Benkan|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Benkan|qq=}} ({{ill|Chūben|ja|左右中弁|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chūben|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} or {{ill|Shōben|ja|少弁|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shōben|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 弁官}}) of the [[:en:Daijō-kan|Daijō-kan]], {{ill|Daibu|ja|大輔|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Daibu|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 日本の官制}} of the {{ill|Eight Ministries|ja|八省|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Eight Ministries|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 日本の官制}}, {{ill|Ōbanshi|ja|大判事|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōbanshi|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 刑部省}}, {{ill|Ōzen-shoku|ja|大膳職|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōzen-shoku|qq=}} (Ōzen-daibu), [[:en:Major general|Shōshō]] of the {{ill|Konoe Guards|ja|近衛府|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Konoe Guards|qq=}}, and {{ill|Ōkan|ja|衛門府|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōkan|qq=}}. These positions marked the middle-tier bureaucratic status.
In the {{ill|samurai|ja|武家|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/samurai|qq=|comment=enwiki is a redirect}} class, the [[:en:Hōjō clan|Hōjō clan]] received this Rank during the [[:en:Kamakura period|Kamakura period]], while it was granted to [[:en:Daimyo|daimyō]] during the [[:en:Toyotomi clan|Toyotomi regime]]. However, during the [[:en:Edo period|Edo period]], appointments to Shōgoi decreased as focus shifted to {{ill|Jūshi'i|ja|従四位|1=Junior Fourth Rank|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jūshi'i|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fourth Rank|qq=}} and {{ill|Jūgoi|ja|従五位|1=Junior Fifth Rank|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jūgoi|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fifth Rank|qq=}}. In this era, the Rank was mainly awarded to {{ill|court officials|ja|宮廷|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/court officials|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 宮殿}} like {{ill|Chikashōnin|ja|地下官人|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chikashōnin|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 地下人}} serving the [[:en:Royal court|Imperial court]], {{ill|Shinnōke|ja|親王家|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shinnōke|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 世襲親王家}}, {{ill|Gosekke|ja|五摂家|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gosekke|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 摂家}}, and {{ill|Seiga families|ja|清華家|1=Seiga families|2=ja|3=清華家|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Seiga families|qq=}}.
From the [[:en:Meiji era|Meiji era]], with the enactment of the {{ill|Rank Grant Ordinance|ja|叙位条例|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Rank Grant Ordinance|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, Ranks above {{ill|Jūshi'i|ja|従四位|1=Junior Fourth Rank|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jūshi'i|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fourth Rank|qq=}} were granted by imperial decree, while Shōgoi and below were conferred by submission (奏授). This Rank often recognized mid-level samurai, [[:en:Military personnel|military officers]], and [[:en:Bureaucrat|bureaucrats]], especially those with notable contributions during the [[:en:Meiji Restoration|Meiji Restoration]]. Historical figures awarded the posthumous Shōgoi include [[:en:Mamiya Rinzō|Mamiya Rinzō]] (granted in [[:en:1904|1904]]) and [[:en:Kanezawa Sanetoki|Hōjō Sanetoki]] (granted in [[:en:1915|1915]]) for cultural accomplishments like founding the [[:en:Kanazawa Bunko|Kanazawa Library]].
Under the current system, Ranks are conferred posthumously as honors. Recipients often include distinguished [[:en:University|university]] and {{ill|college|ja|短期大学|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/college|qq=|comment=enwiki is a redirect}} professors, [[:en:Business manager|business leaders]], {{ill|civil servants|ja|公務員|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/civil servants|qq=|comment=enwiki is a redirect}}, and notable [[:en:Scholar|scholars]], {{ill|artists|ja|芸術家|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/artists|qq=}}, and {{ill|performers|ja|芸能人|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/performers|qq=}} who received awards like the {{ill|Order of the Rising Sun, Gold Rays with Neck Ribbon|ja|旭日中綬章|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Order of the Rising Sun, Gold Rays with Neck Ribbon|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 旭日章}}.

{{出典の明記|date=2015th year 8月}} '''Shōgoi''' (正五位) is one of the Ranks in the [[:en:Japan|Japanese]] [[:en:Ritsuryō|Ritsuryō system]] and [[Shinkai (divine rank)|Shinkai (divine Ranks)]]. It is positioned below {{ill|Junior Fourth Rank|ja|従四位|1=Junior Fourth Rank|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fourth Rank|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fourth Rank|qq=}} and above {{ill|Junior Fifth Rank|ja|従五位|1=Junior Fifth Rank|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fifth Rank|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fifth Rank|qq=}}.<ref>https://www.wakapoetry.net/background/society/court-offices-titles-and-Ranks/court-Ranks/</ref> Posthumous Ranks for this level are referred to as ''Zōshōgoi''.
== Overview ==
Shōgoi, under the [[:en:Ritsuryō|Ritsuryō system]], was divided into upper and lower grades. These positions marked the middle-tier bureaucratic status.
In the {{ill|samurai|ja|武家|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/samurai|qq=|comment=enwiki is a redirect}} class, the [[:en:Hōjō clan|Hōjō clan]] received this Rank during the [[:en:Kamakura period|Kamakura period]], while it was granted to [[:en:Daimyo|daimyō]] during the [[:en:Toyotomi clan|Toyotomi regime]]. In this era, the Rank was mainly awarded to {{ill|court officials|ja|宮廷|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/court officials|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 宮殿}} like {{ill|Chikashōnin|ja|地下官人|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chikashōnin|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 地下人}} serving the [[:en:Royal court|Imperial court]], {{ill|Shinnōke|ja|親王家|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shinnōke|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 世襲親王家}}, {{ill|Gosekke|ja|五摂家|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gosekke|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 摂家}}, and {{ill|Seiga families|ja|清華家|1=Seiga families|2=ja|3=清華家|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Seiga families|qq=}}.
From the [[:en:Meiji era|Meiji era]], with the enactment of the {{ill|Rank Grant Ordinance|ja|叙位条例|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Rank Grant Ordinance|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, Ranks above {{ill|Jūshi'i|ja|従四位|1=Junior Fourth Rank|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jūshi'i|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fourth Rank|qq=}} were granted by imperial decree, while Shōgoi and below were conferred by submission (奏授). This Rank often recognized mid-level samurai, [[:en:Military personnel|military officers]], and [[:en:Bureaucrat|bureaucrats]], especially those with notable contributions during the [[:en:Meiji Restoration|Meiji Restoration]]. {{Referencesの明記|date=2015th year 8月}}
'''Shōgoi''' (正五位) is one of the Ranks in the [[:en:Japan|Japanese]] [[:en:Ritsuryō|Ritsuryō system]] and [[Shinkai (divine rank)|Shinkai (divine Ranks)]]. It is positioned below {{ill|Junior Fourth Rank|ja|従四位|1=Junior Fourth Rank|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fourth Rank|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fourth Rank|qq=}} and above {{ill|Junior Fifth Rank|ja|従五位|1=Junior Fifth Rank|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fifth Rank|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fifth Rank|qq=}}.<ref>https://www.wakapoetry.net/background/society/court-offices-titles-and-Ranks/court-Ranks/</ref> Posthumous Ranks for this level are referred to as ''Zōshōgoi''.

== Overview ==

Shōgoi, under the [[:en:Ritsuryō|Ritsuryō system]], was divided into upper and lower grades. In terms of {{ill|official Ranks|ja|官位|1=East Asian government service ranking|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/official Ranks|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan'i system|qq=|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11452076}}, it corresponded primarily to {{ill|Kyōkan|ja|京官|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kyōkan|qq=|1=Central officials|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q10883145}} (capitals officers), especially positions such as {{ill|Benkan|ja|弁官|1=benkan|lt=Benkan|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Benkan|qq=|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q3270768}} ({{ill|Chūben|ja|左右中弁|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chūben|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} or {{ill|Shōben|ja|少弁|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shōben|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 弁官|1=benkan|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q3270768}}) of the [[:en:Daijō-kan|Daijō-kan]], {{ill|Daibu|ja|大輔|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Daibu|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 日本の官制|1=structure of the ritsuryō government|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q8193883}} of the {{ill|Eight Ministries|ja|八省|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Eight Ministries|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 日本の官制|1=structure of the ritsuryō government|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q8193883}}, {{ill|Ōbanshi|ja|大判事|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōbanshi|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 刑部省|1=Ministry of Justice|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q6867320}}, {{ill|Ōzen-shoku|ja|大膳職|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōzen-shoku|qq=|1=Dazai Gon no Daibu|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11438575}} (Ōzen-daibu), [[:en:Major general|Shōshō]] of the {{ill|Konoe Guards|ja|近衛府|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Konoe Guards|qq=|1=Konoefu|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11638974}}, and {{ill|Ōkan|ja|衛門府|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōkan|qq=|1=Emonfu|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11626338}}. These positions marked the middle-tier bureaucratic status.

In the {{ill|samurai|ja|武家|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/samurai|qq=|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=buke|WD=Q2927809}} class, the [[:en:Hōjō clan|Hōjō clan]] received this Rank during the [[:en:Kamakura period|Kamakura period]], while it was granted to [[:en:Daimyo|daimyō]] during the [[:en:Toyotomi clan|Toyotomi regime]]. However, during the [[:en:Edo period|Edo period]], appointments to Shōgoi decreased as focus shifted to {{ill|Jūshi'i|ja|従四位|1=Junior Fourth Rank|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jūshi'i|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fourth Rank|qq=}} and {{ill|Jūgoi|ja|従五位|1=Junior Fifth Rank|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jūgoi|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fifth Rank|qq=}}. In this era, the Rank was mainly awarded to {{ill|court officials|ja|宮廷|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/court officials|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 宮殿|1=palace|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q16560}} like {{ill|Chikashōnin|ja|地下官人|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chikashōnin|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 地下人|1=jige officials|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11424047}} serving the [[:en:Royal court|Imperial court]], {{ill|Shinnōke|ja|親王家|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shinnōke|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 世襲親王家|1=Seshū Shinnōke|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q848622}}, {{ill|Gosekke|ja|五摂家|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gosekke|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 摂家|1=Five regent houses|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1067142}}, and {{ill|Seiga families|ja|清華家|1=Seiga families|2=ja|3=清華家|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Seiga families|qq=}}.

From the [[:en:Meiji era|Meiji era]], with the enactment of the {{ill|Rank Grant Ordinance|ja|叙位条例|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Rank Grant Ordinance|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, Ranks above {{ill|Jūshi'i|ja|従四位|1=Junior Fourth Rank|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jūshi'i|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fourth Rank|qq=}} were granted by imperial decree, while Shōgoi and below were conferred by submission (奏授). This Rank often recognized mid-level samurai, [[:en:Military personnel|military officers]], and [[:en:Bureaucrat|bureaucrats]], especially those with notable contributions during the [[:en:Meiji Restoration|Meiji Restoration]]. Historical figures awarded the posthumous Shōgoi include [[:en:Mamiya Rinzō|Mamiya Rinzō]] (granted in [[:en:1904|1904]]) and [[:en:Kanezawa Sanetoki|Hōjō Sanetoki]] (granted in [[:en:1915|1915]]) for cultural accomplishments like founding the [[:en:Kanazawa Bunko|Kanazawa Library]].

Under the current system, Ranks are conferred posthumously as honors. Recipients often include distinguished [[:en:University|university]] and {{ill|college|ja|短期大学|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/college|qq=|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=junior college in Japan|WD=Q110296306}} professors, [[:en:Business manager|business leaders]], {{ill|civil servants|ja|公務員|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/civil servants|qq=|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=civil servant|WD=Q212238}}, and notable [[:en:Scholar|scholars]], {{ill|artists|ja|芸術家|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/artists|qq=|1=artist|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q847689}}, and {{ill|performers|ja|芸能人|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/performers|qq=|1=public entertainer|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1899943}} who received awards like the {{ill|Order of the Rising Sun, Gold Rays with Neck Ribbon|ja|旭日中綬章|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Order of the Rising Sun, Gold Rays with Neck Ribbon|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 旭日章|1=Order of the Rising Sun|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q818600}}.

In this era, the Rank was mainly awarded to {{ill|court officials|ja|宮廷|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/court officials|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 宮殿|1=palace|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q16560}} like {{ill|Chikashōnin|ja|地下官人|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chikashōnin|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 地下人|1=jige officials|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11424047}} serving the [[:en:Royal court|Imperial court]], {{ill|Shinnōke|ja|親王家|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shinnōke|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 世襲親王家|1=Seshū Shinnōke|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q848622}}, {{ill|Gosekke|ja|五摂家|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gosekke|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 摂家|1=Five regent houses|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1067142}}, and {{ill|Seiga families|ja|清華家|1=Seiga families|2=ja|3=清華家|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Seiga families|qq=}}.

From the [[:en:Meiji era|Meiji era]], with the enactment of the {{ill|Rank Grant Ordinance|ja|叙位条例|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Rank Grant Ordinance|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, Ranks above {{ill|Jūshi'i|ja|従四位|1=Junior Fourth Rank|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jūshi'i|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fourth Rank|qq=}} were granted by imperial decree, while Shōgoi and below were conferred by submission (奏授). This Rank often recognized mid-level samurai, [[:en:Military personnel|military officers]], and [[:en:Bureaucrat|bureaucrats]], especially those with notable contributions during the [[:en:Meiji Restoration|Meiji Restoration]]. Historical figures awarded the posthumous Shōgoi include [[:en:Mamiya Rinzō|Mamiya Rinzō]] (granted in [[:en:1904|1904]]) and [[:en:Kanezawa Sanetoki|Hōjō Sanetoki]] (granted in [[:en:1915|1915]]) for cultural accomplishments like founding the [[:en:Kanazawa Bunko|Kanazawa Library]].

Under the current system, Ranks are conferred posthumously as honors. Recipients often include distinguished [[:en:University|university]] and {{ill|college|ja|短期大学|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/college|qq=|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=junior college in Japan|WD=Q110296306}} professors, [[:en:Business manager|business leaders]], {{ill|civil servants|ja|公務員|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/civil servants|qq=|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=civil servant|WD=Q212238}}, and notable [[:en:Scholar|scholars]], {{ill|artists|ja|芸術家|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/artists|qq=|1=artist|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q847689}}, and {{ill|performers|ja|芸能人|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/performers|qq=|1=public entertainer|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1899943}} who received awards like the {{ill|Order of the Rising Sun, Gold Rays with Neck Ribbon|ja|旭日中綬章|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Order of the Rising Sun, Gold Rays with Neck Ribbon|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 旭日章|1=Order of the Rising Sun|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q818600}}.

'''Shōgoi''' (正五位) is one of the Ranks in the [[:en:Japan|Japanese]] [[:en:Ritsuryō|Ritsuryō system]] and [[Shinkai (divine rank)|Shinkai (divine Ranks)]]. It is positioned below {{ill|Junior Fourth Rank|ja|従四位|1=Junior Fourth Rank|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fourth Rank|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fourth Rank|qq=}} and above {{ill|Junior Fifth Rank|ja|従五位|1=Junior Fifth Rank|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fifth Rank|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fifth Rank|qq=}}.<ref>https://www.wakapoetry.net/background/society/court-offices-titles-and-Ranks/court-Ranks/</ref> Posthumous Ranks for this level are referred to as ''Zōshōgoi''.

== Overview ==

Shōgoi, under the [[:en:Ritsuryō|Ritsuryō system]], was divided into upper and lower grades. In terms of {{ill|official Ranks|ja|官位|1=East Asian government service ranking|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/official Ranks|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan'i system|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11452076}}, it corresponded primarily to {{ill|Kyōkan|ja|京官|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kyōkan|1=Central officials|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q10883145}} (capitals officers), especially positions such as {{ill|Benkan|ja|弁官|1=benkan|lt=Benkan|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Benkan|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q3270768}} ({{ill|Chūben|ja|左右中弁|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chūben|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} or {{ill|Shōben|ja|少弁|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shōben|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 弁官|1=benkan|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q3270768}}) of the [[:en:Daijō-kan|Daijō-kan]], {{ill|Daibu|ja|大輔|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Daibu|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 日本の官制|1=structure of the ritsuryō government|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q8193883}} of the {{ill|Eight Ministries|ja|八省|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Eight Ministries|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 日本の官制|1=structure of the ritsuryō government|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q8193883}}, {{ill|Ōbanshi|ja|大判事|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōbanshi|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 刑部省|1=Ministry of Justice|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q6867320}}, {{ill|Ōzen-shoku|ja|大膳職|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōzen-shoku|1=Dazai Gon no Daibu|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11438575}} (Ōzen-daibu), [[:en:Major general|Shōshō]] of the {{ill|Konoe Guards|ja|近衛府|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Konoe Guards|1=Konoefu|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11638974}}, and {{ill|Ōkan|ja|衛門府|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōkan|1=Emonfu|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11626338}}. These positions marked the middle-tier bureaucratic status.

In the {{ill|samurai|ja|武家|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/samurai|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=buke|WD=Q2927809}} class, the [[:en:Hōjō clan|Hōjō clan]] received this Rank during the [[:en:Kamakura period|Kamakura period]], while it was granted to [[:en:Daimyo|daimyō]] during the [[:en:Toyotomi clan|Toyotomi regime]]. However, during the [[:en:Edo period|Edo period]], appointments to Shōgoi decreased as focus shifted to {{ill|Jūshi'i|ja|従四位|1=Junior Fourth Rank|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jūshi'i|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fourth Rank|qq=}} and {{ill|Jūgoi|ja|従五位|1=Junior Fifth Rank|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jūgoi|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fifth Rank|qq=}}. '''Shōgoi''' (正五位) is one of the Ranks in the [[:en:Japan|Japanese]] [[:en:Ritsuryō|Ritsuryō system]] and [[Shinkai (divine rank)|Shinkai (divine Ranks)]]. It is positioned below {{ill|Junior Fourth Rank|ja|従四位|1=Junior Fourth Rank|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fourth Rank|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fourth Rank|qq=}} and above {{ill|Junior Fifth Rank|ja|従五位|1=Junior Fifth Rank|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fifth Rank|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fifth Rank|qq=}}.<ref>https://www.wakapoetry.net/background/society/court-offices-titles-and-Ranks/court-Ranks/</ref> Posthumous Ranks for this level are referred to as ''Zōshōgoi''.

== Overview ==

Shōgoi, under the [[:en:Ritsuryō|Ritsuryō system]], was divided into upper and lower grades. In terms of {{ill|official Ranks|ja|官位|1=East Asian government service ranking|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/official Ranks|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan'i system|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11452076}}, it corresponded primarily to {{ill|Kyōkan|ja|京官|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kyōkan|1=Central officials|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q10883145}} (capitals officers), especially positions such as {{ill|Benkan|ja|弁官|1=benkan|lt=Benkan|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Benkan|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q3270768}} ({{ill|Chūben|ja|左右中弁|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chūben|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} or {{ill|Shōben|ja|少弁|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shōben|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 弁官|1=benkan|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q3270768}}) of the [[:en:Daijō-kan|Daijō-kan]], {{ill|Daibu|ja|大輔|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Daibu|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 日本の官制|1=structure of the ritsuryō government|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q8193883}} of the {{ill|Eight Ministries|ja|八省|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Eight Ministries|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 日本の官制|1=structure of the ritsuryō government|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q8193883}}, {{ill|Ōbanshi|ja|大判事|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōbanshi|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 刑部省|1=Ministry of Justice|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q6867320}}, {{ill|Ōzen-shoku|ja|大膳職|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōzen-shoku|1=Dazai Gon no Daibu|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11438575}} (Ōzen-daibu), [[:en:Major general|Shōshō]] of the {{ill|Konoe Guards|ja|近衛府|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Konoe Guards|1=Konoefu|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11638974}}, and {{ill|Ōkan|ja|衛門府|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōkan|1=Emonfu|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11626338}}. These positions marked the middle-tier bureaucratic status.

In the {{ill|samurai|ja|武家|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/samurai|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=buke|WD=Q2927809}} class, the [[:en:Hōjō clan|Hōjō clan]] received this Rank during the [[:en:Kamakura period|Kamakura period]], while it was granted to [[:en:Daimyo|daimyō]] during the [[:en:Toyotomi clan|Toyotomi regime]]. However, during the [[:en:Edo period|Edo period]], appointments to Shōgoi decreased as focus shifted to {{ill|Jūshi'i|ja|従四位|1=Junior Fourth Rank|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jūshi'i|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fourth Rank|qq=}} and {{ill|Jūgoi|ja|従五位|1=Junior Fifth Rank|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jūgoi|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fifth Rank|qq=}}. In this era, the Rank was mainly awarded to {{ill|court officials|ja|宮廷|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/court officials|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 宮殿|1=palace|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q16560}} like {{ill|Chikashōnin|ja|地下官人|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chikashōnin|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 地下人|1=jige officials|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11424047}} serving the [[:en:Royal court|Imperial court]], {{ill|Shinnōke|ja|親王家|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shinnōke|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 世襲親王家|1=Seshū Shinnōke|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q848622}}, {{ill|Gosekke|ja|五摂家|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gosekke|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 摂家|1=Five regent houses|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1067142}}, and {{ill|Seiga families|ja|清華家|1=Seiga families|2=ja|3=清華家|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Seiga families|qq=}}.

From the [[:en:Meiji era|Meiji era]], with the enactment of the {{ill|Rank Grant Ordinance|ja|叙位条例|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Rank Grant Ordinance|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, Ranks above {{ill|Jūshi'i|ja|従四位|1=Junior Fourth Rank|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jūshi'i|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fourth Rank|qq=}} were granted by imperial decree, while Shōgoi and below were conferred by submission (奏授). This Rank often recognized mid-level samurai, [[:en:Military personnel|military officers]], and [[:en:Bureaucrat|bureaucrats]], especially those with notable contributions during the [[:en:Meiji Restoration|Meiji Restoration]]. Historical figures awarded the posthumous Shōgoi include [[:en:Mamiya Rinzō|Mamiya Rinzō]] (granted in [[:en:1904|1904]]) and [[:en:Kanezawa Sanetoki|Hōjō Sanetoki]] (granted in [[:en:1915|1915]]) for cultural accomplishments like founding the [[:en:Kanazawa Bunko|Kanazawa Library]].

Under the current system, Ranks are conferred posthumously as honors. Recipients often include distinguished [[:en:University|university]] and {{ill|college|ja|短期大学|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/college|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=junior college in Japan|WD=Q110296306}} professors, [[:en:Business manager|business leaders]], {{ill|civil servants|ja|公務員|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/civil servants|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=civil servant|WD=Q212238}}, and notable [[:en:Scholar|scholars]], {{ill|artists|ja|芸術家|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/artists|1=artist|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q847689}}, and {{ill|performers|ja|芸能人|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/performers|1=public entertainer|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1899943}} who received awards like the {{ill|Order of the Rising Sun, Gold Rays with Neck Ribbon|ja|旭日中綬章|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Order of the Rising Sun, Gold Rays with Neck Ribbon|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 旭日章|1=Order of the Rising Sun|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q818600}}.

From the [[:en:Meiji era|Meiji era]], with the enactment of the {{ill|Rank Grant Ordinance|ja|叙位条例|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Rank Grant Ordinance|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, Ranks above {{ill|Jūshi'i|ja|従四位|1=Junior Fourth Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jūshi'i|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fourth Rank|qq=}} were granted by imperial decree, while Shōgoi and below were conferred by submission (奏授). This Rank often recognized mid-level samurai, [[:en:Military personnel|military officers]], and [[:en:Bureaucrat|bureaucrats]], especially those with notable contributions during the [[:en:Meiji Restoration|Meiji Restoration]]. Historical figures awarded the posthumous Shōgoi include [[:en:Mamiya Rinzō|Mamiya Rinzō]] (granted in [[:en:1904|1904]]) and [[:en:Kanezawa Sanetoki|Hōjō Sanetoki]] (granted in [[:en:1915|1915]]) for cultural accomplishments like founding the [[:en:Kanazawa Bunko|Kanazawa Library]].

{{Referencesの明記|date=2015th year 8月}}
'''Shōgoi''' (正五位) is one of the Ranks in the [[:en:Japan|Japanese]] [[:en:Ritsuryō|Ritsuryō system]] and [[Shinkai (divine rank)|Shinkai (divine Ranks)]]. It is positioned below {{ill|Junior Fourth Rank|ja|従四位|1=Junior Fourth Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fourth Rank|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fourth Rank|qq=}} and above {{ill|Junior Fifth Rank|ja|従五位|1=Junior Fifth Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fifth Rank|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fifth Rank|qq=}}.<ref>https://www.wakapoetry.net/background/society/court-offices-titles-and-Ranks/court-Ranks/</ref> Posthumous Ranks for this level are referred to as ''Zōshōgoi''.

== Overview ==

Shōgoi, under the [[:en:Ritsuryō|Ritsuryō system]], was divided into upper and lower grades. In terms of {{ill|official Ranks|ja|官位|1=East Asian government service ranking|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/official Ranks|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan'i system|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11452076}}, it corresponded primarily to {{ill|Kyōkan|ja|京官|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kyōkan|1=Central officials|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q10883145}} (capitals officers), especially positions such as {{ill|Benkan|ja|弁官|1=benkan|lt=Benkan|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Benkan|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q3270768}} ({{ill|Chūben|ja|左右中弁|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chūben|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} or {{ill|Shōben|ja|少弁|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shōben|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 弁官|1=benkan|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q3270768}}) of the [[:en:Daijō-kan|Daijō-kan]], {{ill|Daibu|ja|大輔|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Daibu|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 日本の官制|1=structure of the ritsuryō government|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q8193883}} of the {{ill|Eight Ministries|ja|八省|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Eight Ministries|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 日本の官制|1=structure of the ritsuryō government|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q8193883}}, {{ill|Ōbanshi|ja|大判事|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōbanshi|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 刑部省|1=Ministry of Justice|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q6867320}}, {{ill|Ōzen-shoku|ja|大膳職|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōzen-shoku|1=Dazai Gon no Daibu|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11438575}} (Ōzen-daibu), [[:en:Major general|Shōshō]] of the {{ill|Konoe Guards|ja|近衛府|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Konoe Guards|1=Konoefu|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11638974}}, and {{ill|Ōkan|ja|衛門府|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōkan|1=Emonfu|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11626338}}. These positions marked the middle-tier bureaucratic status.

In the {{ill|samurai|ja|武家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/samurai|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=buke|WD=Q2927809}} class, the [[:en:Hōjō clan|Hōjō clan]] received this Rank during the [[:en:Kamakura period|Kamakura period]], while it was granted to [[:en:Daimyo|daimyō]] during the [[:en:Toyotomi clan|Toyotomi regime]]. However, during the [[:en:Edo period|Edo period]], appointments to Shōgoi decreased as focus shifted to {{ill|Jūshi'i|ja|従四位|1=Junior Fourth Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jūshi'i|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fourth Rank|qq=}} and {{ill|Jūgoi|ja|従五位|1=Junior Fifth Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jūgoi|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fifth Rank|qq=}}. In this era, the Rank was mainly awarded to {{ill|court officials|ja|宮廷|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/court officials|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 宮殿|1=palace|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q16560}} like {{ill|Chikashōnin|ja|地下官人|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chikashōnin|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 地下人|1=jige officials|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11424047}} serving the [[:en:Royal court|Imperial court]], {{ill|Shinnōke|ja|親王家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shinnōke|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 世襲親王家|1=Seshū Shinnōke|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q848622}}, {{ill|Gosekke|ja|五摂家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gosekke|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 摂家|1=Five regent houses|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1067142}}, and {{ill|Seiga families|ja|清華家|1=Seiga families|2=ja|3=清華家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Seiga families|qq=}}.

From the [[:en:Meiji era|Meiji era]], with the enactment of the {{ill|Rank Grant Ordinance|ja|叙位条例|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Rank Grant Ordinance|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, Ranks above {{ill|Jūshi'i|ja|従四位|1=Junior Fourth Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jūshi'i|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fourth Rank|qq=}} were granted by imperial decree, while Shōgoi and below were conferred by submission (奏授). This Rank often recognized mid-level samurai, [[:en:Military personnel|military officers]], and [[:en:Bureaucrat|bureaucrats]], especially those with notable contributions during the [[:en:Meiji Restoration|Meiji Restoration]]. Historical figures awarded the posthumous Shōgoi include [[:en:Mamiya Rinzō|Mamiya Rinzō]] (granted in [[:en:1904|1904]]) and [[:en:Kanezawa Sanetoki|Hōjō Sanetoki]] (granted in [[:en:1915|1915]]) for cultural accomplishments like founding the [[:en:Kanazawa Bunko|Kanazawa Library]].

Under the current system, Ranks are conferred posthumously as honors. Recipients often include distinguished [[:en:University|university]] and {{ill|college|ja|短期大学|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/college|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=junior college in Japan|WD=Q110296306}} professors, [[:en:Business manager|business leaders]], {{ill|civil servants|ja|公務員|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/civil servants|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=civil servant|WD=Q212238}}, and notable [[:en:Scholar|scholars]], {{ill|artists|ja|芸術家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/artists|1=artist|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q847689}}, and {{ill|performers|ja|芸能人|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/performers|1=public entertainer|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1899943}} who received awards like the {{ill|Order of the Rising Sun, Gold Rays with Neck Ribbon|ja|旭日中綬章|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Order of the Rising Sun, Gold Rays with Neck Ribbon|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 旭日章|1=Order of the Rising Sun|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q818600}}.

'''Shōgoi''' (正五位) is one of the Ranks in the [[:en:Japan|Japanese]] [[:en:Ritsuryō|Ritsuryō system]] and [[Shinkai (divine rank)|Shinkai (divine Ranks)]]. It is positioned below {{ill|Junior Fourth Rank|ja|従四位|1=Junior Fourth Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fourth Rank|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fourth Rank|qq=}} and above {{ill|Junior Fifth Rank|ja|従五位|1=Junior Fifth Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fifth Rank|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fifth Rank|qq=}}.<ref>https://www.wakapoetry.net/background/society/court-offices-titles-and-Ranks/court-Ranks/</ref> Posthumous Ranks for this level are referred to as ''Zōshōgoi''.

== Overview ==

Shōgoi, under the [[:en:Ritsuryō|Ritsuryō system]], was divided into upper and lower grades. In terms of {{ill|official Ranks|ja|官位|1=East Asian government service ranking|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/official Ranks|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan'i system|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11452076}}, it corresponded primarily to {{ill|Kyōkan|ja|京官|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kyōkan|1=Central officials|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q10883145}} (capitals officers), especially positions such as {{ill|Benkan|ja|弁官|1=benkan|lt=Benkan|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Benkan|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q3270768}} ({{ill|Chūben|ja|左右中弁|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chūben|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} or {{ill|Shōben|ja|少弁|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shōben|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 弁官|1=benkan|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q3270768}}) of the [[:en:Daijō-kan|Daijō-kan]], {{ill|Daibu|ja|大輔|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Daibu|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 日本の官制|1=structure of the ritsuryō government|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q8193883}} of the {{ill|Eight Ministries|ja|八省|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Eight Ministries|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 日本の官制|1=structure of the ritsuryō government|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q8193883}}, {{ill|Ōbanshi|ja|大判事|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōbanshi|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 刑部省|1=Ministry of Justice|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q6867320}}, {{ill|Ōzen-shoku|ja|大膳職|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōzen-shoku|1=Dazai Gon no Daibu|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11438575}} (Ōzen-daibu), [[:en:Major general|Shōshō]] of the {{ill|Konoe Guards|ja|近衛府|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Konoe Guards|1=Konoefu|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11638974}}, and {{ill|Ōkan|ja|衛門府|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōkan|1=Emonfu|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11626338}}. These positions marked the middle-tier bureaucratic status.

In the {{ill|samurai|ja|武家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/samurai|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=buke|WD=Q2927809}} class, the [[:en:Hōjō clan|Hōjō clan]] received this Rank during the [[:en:Kamakura period|Kamakura period]], while it was granted to [[:en:Daimyo|daimyō]] during the [[:en:Toyotomi clan|Toyotomi regime]]. However, during the [[:en:Edo period|Edo period]], appointments to Shōgoi decreased as focus shifted to {{ill|Jūshi'i|ja|従四位|1=Junior Fourth Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jūshi'i|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fourth Rank|qq=}} and {{ill|Jūgoi|ja|従五位|1=Junior Fifth Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jūgoi|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fifth Rank|qq=}}. In this era, the Rank was mainly awarded to {{ill|court officials|ja|宮廷|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/court officials|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 宮殿|1=palace|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q16560}} like {{ill|Chikashōnin|ja|地下官人|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chikashōnin|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 地下人|1=jige officials|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11424047}} serving the [[:en:Royal court|Imperial court]], {{ill|Shinnōke|ja|親王家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shinnōke|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 世襲親王家|1=Seshū Shinnōke|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q848622}}, {{ill|Gosekke|ja|五摂家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gosekke|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 摂家|1=Five regent houses|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1067142}}, and {{ill|Seiga families|ja|清華家|1=Seiga families|2=ja|3=清華家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Seiga families|qq=}}.

From the [[:en:Meiji era|Meiji era]], with the enactment of the {{ill|Rank Grant Ordinance|ja|叙位条例|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Rank Grant Ordinance|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, Ranks above {{ill|Jūshi'i|ja|従四位|1=Junior Fourth Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jūshi'i|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fourth Rank|qq=}} were granted by imperial decree, while Shōgoi and below were conferred by submission (奏授). This Rank often recognized mid-level samurai, [[:en:Military personnel|military officers]], and [[:en:Bureaucrat|bureaucrats]], especially those with notable contributions during the [[:en:Meiji Restoration|Meiji Restoration]]. Historical figures awarded the posthumous Shōgoi include [[:en:Mamiya Rinzō|Mamiya Rinzō]] (granted in [[:en:1904|1904]]) and [[:en:Kanezawa Sanetoki|Hōjō Sanetoki]] (granted in [[:en:1915|1915]]) for cultural accomplishments like founding the [[:en:Kanazawa Bunko|Kanazawa Library]].

Under the current system, Ranks are conferred posthumously as honors. Recipients often include distinguished [[:en:University|university]] and {{ill|college|ja|短期大学|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/college|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=junior college in Japan|WD=Q110296306}} professors, [[:en:Business manager|business leaders]], {{ill|civil servants|ja|公務員|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/civil servants|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=civil servant|WD=Q212238}}, and notable [[:en:Scholar|scholars]], {{ill|artists|ja|芸術家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/artists|1=artist|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q847689}}, and {{ill|performers|ja|芸能人|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/performers|1=public entertainer|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1899943}} who received awards like the {{ill|Order of the Rising Sun, Gold Rays with Neck Ribbon|ja|旭日中綬章|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Order of the Rising Sun, Gold Rays with Neck Ribbon|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 旭日章|1=Order of the Rising Sun|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q818600}}.

{{Referencesの明記|date=2015th year 8月}}
'''Shōgoi''' (正五位) is one of the Ranks in the [[:en:Japan|Japanese]] [[:en:Ritsuryō|Ritsuryō system]] and [[Shinkai (divine rank)|Shinkai (divine Ranks)]]. It is positioned below {{ill|Junior Fourth Rank|ja|従四位|1=Junior Fourth Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fourth Rank|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fourth Rank|qq=}} and above {{ill|Junior Fifth Rank|ja|従五位|1=Junior Fifth Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fifth Rank|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fifth Rank|qq=}}.<ref>https://www.wakapoetry.net/background/society/court-offices-titles-and-Ranks/court-Ranks/</ref> Posthumous Ranks for this level are referred to as ''Zōshōgoi''.

== Overview ==

Shōgoi, under the [[:en:Ritsuryō|Ritsuryō system]], was divided into upper and lower grades. In terms of {{ill|official Ranks|ja|官位|1=East Asian government service ranking|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/official Ranks|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan'i system|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11452076}}, it corresponded primarily to {{ill|Kyōkan|ja|京官|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kyōkan|1=Central officials|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q10883145}} (capitals officers), especially positions such as {{ill|Benkan|ja|弁官|1=benkan|lt=Benkan|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Benkan|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q3270768}} ({{ill|Chūben|ja|左右中弁|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chūben|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} or {{ill|Shōben|ja|少弁|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shōben|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 弁官|1=benkan|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q3270768}}) of the [[:en:Daijō-kan|Daijō-kan]], {{ill|Daibu|ja|大輔|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Daibu|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 日本の官制|1=structure of the ritsuryō government|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q8193883}} of the {{ill|Eight Ministries|ja|八省|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Eight Ministries|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 日本の官制|1=structure of the ritsuryō government|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q8193883}}, {{ill|Ōbanshi|ja|大判事|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōbanshi|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 刑部省|1=Ministry of Justice|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q6867320}}, {{ill|Ōzen-shoku|ja|大膳職|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōzen-shoku|1=Dazai Gon no Daibu|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11438575}} (Ōzen-daibu), [[:en:Major general|Shōshō]] of the {{ill|Konoe Guards|ja|近衛府|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Konoe Guards|1=Konoefu|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11638974}}, and {{ill|Ōkan|ja|衛門府|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōkan|1=Emonfu|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11626338}}. These positions marked the middle-tier bureaucratic status.

In the {{ill|samurai|ja|武家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/samurai|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=buke|WD=Q2927809}} class, the [[:en:Hōjō clan|Hōjō clan]] received this Rank during the [[:en:Kamakura period|Kamakura period]], while it was granted to [[:en:Daimyo|daimyō]] during the [[:en:Toyotomi clan|Toyotomi regime]]. However, during the [[:en:Edo period|Edo period]], appointments to Shōgoi decreased as focus shifted to {{ill|Jūshi'i|ja|従四位|1=Junior Fourth Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jūshi'i|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fourth Rank|qq=}} and {{ill|Jūgoi|ja|従五位|1=Junior Fifth Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jūgoi|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fifth Rank|qq=}}. In this era, the Rank was mainly awarded to {{ill|court officials|ja|宮廷|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/court officials|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 宮殿|1=palace|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q16560}} like {{ill|Chikashōnin|ja|地下官人|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chikashōnin|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 地下人|1=jige officials|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11424047}} serving the [[:en:Royal court|Imperial court]], {{ill|Shinnōke|ja|親王家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shinnōke|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 世襲親王家|1=Seshū Shinnōke|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q848622}}, {{ill|Gosekke|ja|五摂家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gosekke|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 摂家|1=Five regent houses|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1067142}}, and {{ill|Seiga families|ja|清華家|1=Seiga families|2=ja|3=清華家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Seiga families|qq=}}.

From the [[:en:Meiji era|Meiji era]], with the enactment of the {{ill|Rank Grant Ordinance|ja|叙位条例|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Rank Grant Ordinance|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, Ranks above {{ill|Jūshi'i|ja|従四位|1=Junior Fourth Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jūshi'i|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fourth Rank|qq=}} were granted by imperial decree, while Shōgoi and below were conferred by submission (奏授). This Rank often recognized mid-level samurai, [[:en:Military personnel|military officers]], and [[:en:Bureaucrat|bureaucrats]], especially those with notable contributions during the [[:en:Meiji Restoration|Meiji Restoration]]. Historical figures awarded the posthumous Shōgoi include [[:en:Mamiya Rinzō|Mamiya Rinzō]] (granted in [[:en:1904|1904]]) and [[:en:Kanezawa Sanetoki|Hōjō Sanetoki]] (granted in [[:en:1915|1915]]) for cultural accomplishments like founding the [[:en:Kanazawa Bunko|Kanazawa Library]].

Under the current system, Ranks are conferred posthumously as honors. Recipients often include distinguished [[:en:University|university]] and {{ill|college|ja|短期大学|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/college|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=junior college in Japan|WD=Q110296306}} professors, [[:en:Business manager|business leaders]], {{ill|civil servants|ja|公務員|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/civil servants|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=civil servant|WD=Q212238}}, and notable [[:en:Scholar|scholars]], {{ill|artists|ja|芸術家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/artists|1=artist|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q847689}}, and {{ill|performers|ja|芸能人|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/performers|1=public entertainer|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1899943}} who received awards like the {{ill|Order of the Rising Sun, Gold Rays with Neck Ribbon|ja|旭日中綬章|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Order of the Rising Sun, Gold Rays with Neck Ribbon|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 旭日章|1=Order of the Rising Sun|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q818600}}.

'''Shōgoi''' (正五位) is one of the Ranks in the [[:en:Japan|Japanese]] [[:en:Ritsuryō|Ritsuryō system]] and [[Shinkai (divine rank)|Shinkai (divine Ranks)]]. It is positioned below {{ill|Junior Fourth Rank|ja|従四位|1=Junior Fourth Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fourth Rank|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fourth Rank|qq=}} and above {{ill|Junior Fifth Rank|ja|従五位|1=Junior Fifth Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fifth Rank|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fifth Rank|qq=}}.<ref>https://www.wakapoetry.net/background/society/court-offices-titles-and-Ranks/court-Ranks/</ref> Posthumous Ranks for this level are referred to as ''Zōshōgoi''.

== Overview ==

Shōgoi, under the [[:en:Ritsuryō|Ritsuryō system]], was divided into upper and lower grades. In terms of {{ill|official Ranks|ja|官位|1=East Asian government service ranking|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/official Ranks|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan'i system|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11452076}}, it corresponded primarily to {{ill|Kyōkan|ja|京官|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kyōkan|1=Central officials|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q10883145}} (capitals officers), especially positions such as {{ill|Benkan|ja|弁官|1=benkan|lt=Benkan|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Benkan|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q3270768}} ({{ill|Chūben|ja|左右中弁|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chūben|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} or {{ill|Shōben|ja|少弁|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shōben|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 弁官|1=benkan|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q3270768}}) of the [[:en:Daijō-kan|Daijō-kan]], {{ill|Daibu|ja|大輔|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Daibu|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 日本の官制|1=structure of the ritsuryō government|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q8193883}} of the {{ill|Eight Ministries|ja|八省|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Eight Ministries|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 日本の官制|1=structure of the ritsuryō government|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q8193883}}, {{ill|Ōbanshi|ja|大判事|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōbanshi|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 刑部省|1=Ministry of Justice|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q6867320}}, {{ill|Ōzen-shoku|ja|大膳職|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōzen-shoku|1=Dazai Gon no Daibu|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11438575}} (Ōzen-daibu), [[:en:Major general|Shōshō]] of the {{ill|Konoe Guards|ja|近衛府|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Konoe Guards|1=Konoefu|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11638974}}, and {{ill|Ōkan|ja|衛門府|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōkan|1=Emonfu|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11626338}}. These positions marked the middle-tier bureaucratic status.

In the {{ill|samurai|ja|武家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/samurai|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=buke|WD=Q2927809}} class, the [[:en:Hōjō clan|Hōjō clan]] received this Rank during the [[:en:Kamakura period|Kamakura period]], while it was granted to [[:en:Daimyo|daimyō]] during the [[:en:Toyotomi clan|Toyotomi regime]]. However, during the [[:en:Edo period|Edo period]], appointments to Shōgoi decreased as focus shifted to {{ill|Jūshi'i|ja|従四位|1=Junior Fourth Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jūshi'i|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fourth Rank|qq=}} and {{ill|Jūgoi|ja|従五位|1=Junior Fifth Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jūgoi|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fifth Rank|qq=}}. In this era, the Rank was mainly awarded to {{ill|court officials|ja|宮廷|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/court officials|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 宮殿|1=palace|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q16560}} like {{ill|Chikashōnin|ja|地下官人|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chikashōnin|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 地下人|1=jige officials|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11424047}} serving the [[:en:Royal court|Imperial court]], {{ill|Shinnōke|ja|親王家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shinnōke|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 世襲親王家|1=Seshū Shinnōke|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q848622}}, {{ill|Gosekke|ja|五摂家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gosekke|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 摂家|1=Five regent houses|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1067142}}, and {{ill|Seiga families|ja|清華家|1=Seiga families|2=ja|3=清華家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Seiga families|qq=}}.

From the [[:en:Meiji era|Meiji era]], with the enactment of the {{ill|Rank Grant Ordinance|ja|叙位条例|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Rank Grant Ordinance|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, Ranks above {{ill|Jūshi'i|ja|従四位|1=Junior Fourth Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jūshi'i|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fourth Rank|qq=}} were granted by imperial decree, while Shōgoi and below were conferred by submission (奏授). This Rank often recognized mid-level samurai, [[:en:Military personnel|military officers]], and [[:en:Bureaucrat|bureaucrats]], especially those with notable contributions during the [[:en:Meiji Restoration|Meiji Restoration]]. Historical figures awarded the posthumous Shōgoi include [[:en:Mamiya Rinzō|Mamiya Rinzō]] (granted in [[:en:1904|1904]]) and [[:en:Kanezawa Sanetoki|Hōjō Sanetoki]] (granted in [[:en:1915|1915]]) for cultural accomplishments like founding the [[:en:Kanazawa Bunko|Kanazawa Library]].

Under the current system, Ranks are conferred posthumously as honors. {{Referencesの明記|date=2015th year 8月}}
'''Shōgoi''' (正五位) is one of the Ranks in the [[:en:Japan|Japanese]] [[:en:Ritsuryō|Ritsuryō system]] and [[Shinkai (divine rank)|Shinkai (divine Ranks)]]. It is positioned below {{ill|Junior Fourth Rank|ja|従四位|1=Junior Fourth Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fourth Rank|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fourth Rank|qq=}} and above {{ill|Junior Fifth Rank|ja|従五位|1=Junior Fifth Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fifth Rank|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fifth Rank|qq=}}.<ref>https://www.wakapoetry.net/background/society/court-offices-titles-and-Ranks/court-Ranks/</ref> Posthumous Ranks for this level are referred to as ''Zōshōgoi''.

== Overview ==

Shōgoi, under the [[:en:Ritsuryō|Ritsuryō system]], was divided into upper and lower grades. In terms of {{ill|official Ranks|ja|官位|1=East Asian government service ranking|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/official Ranks|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan'i system|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11452076}}, it corresponded primarily to {{ill|Kyōkan|ja|京官|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kyōkan|1=Central officials|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q10883145}} (capitals officers), especially positions such as {{ill|Benkan|ja|弁官|1=benkan|lt=Benkan|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Benkan|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q3270768}} ({{ill|Chūben|ja|左右中弁|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chūben|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} or {{ill|Shōben|ja|少弁|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shōben|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 弁官|1=benkan|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q3270768}}) of the [[:en:Daijō-kan|Daijō-kan]], {{ill|Daibu|ja|大輔|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Daibu|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 日本の官制|1=structure of the ritsuryō government|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q8193883}} of the {{ill|Eight Ministries|ja|八省|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Eight Ministries|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 日本の官制|1=structure of the ritsuryō government|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q8193883}}, {{ill|Ōbanshi|ja|大判事|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōbanshi|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 刑部省|1=Ministry of Justice|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q6867320}}, {{ill|Ōzen-shoku|ja|大膳職|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōzen-shoku|1=Dazai Gon no Daibu|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11438575}} (Ōzen-daibu), [[:en:Major general|Shōshō]] of the {{ill|Konoe Guards|ja|近衛府|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Konoe Guards|1=Konoefu|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11638974}}, and {{ill|Ōkan|ja|衛門府|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōkan|1=Emonfu|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11626338}}. These positions marked the middle-tier bureaucratic status.

In the {{ill|samurai|ja|武家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/samurai|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=buke|WD=Q2927809}} class, the [[:en:Hōjō clan|Hōjō clan]] received this Rank during the [[:en:Kamakura period|Kamakura period]], while it was granted to [[:en:Daimyo|daimyō]] during the [[:en:Toyotomi clan|Toyotomi regime]]. However, during the [[:en:Edo period|Edo period]], appointments to Shōgoi decreased as focus shifted to {{ill|Jūshi'i|ja|従四位|1=Junior Fourth Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jūshi'i|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fourth Rank|qq=}} and {{ill|Jūgoi|ja|従五位|1=Junior Fifth Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jūgoi|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fifth Rank|qq=}}. In this era, the Rank was mainly awarded to {{ill|court officials|ja|宮廷|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/court officials|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 宮殿|1=palace|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q16560}} like {{ill|Chikashōnin|ja|地下官人|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chikashōnin|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 地下人|1=jige officials|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11424047}} serving the [[:en:Royal court|Imperial court]], {{ill|Shinnōke|ja|親王家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shinnōke|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 世襲親王家|1=Seshū Shinnōke|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q848622}}, {{ill|Gosekke|ja|五摂家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gosekke|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 摂家|1=Five regent houses|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1067142}}, and {{ill|Seiga families|ja|清華家|1=Seiga families|2=ja|3=清華家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Seiga families|qq=}}.

From the [[:en:Meiji era|Meiji era]], with the enactment of the {{ill|Rank Grant Ordinance|ja|叙位条例|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Rank Grant Ordinance|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, Ranks above {{ill|Jūshi'i|ja|従四位|1=Junior Fourth Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jūshi'i|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fourth Rank|qq=}} were granted by imperial decree, while Shōgoi and below were conferred by submission (奏授). This Rank often recognized mid-level samurai, [[:en:Military personnel|military officers]], and [[:en:Bureaucrat|bureaucrats]], especially those with notable contributions during the [[:en:Meiji Restoration|Meiji Restoration]]. Historical figures awarded the posthumous Shōgoi include [[:en:Mamiya Rinzō|Mamiya Rinzō]] (granted in [[:en:1904|1904]]) and [[:en:Kanezawa Sanetoki|Hōjō Sanetoki]] (granted in [[:en:1915|1915]]) for cultural accomplishments like founding the [[:en:Kanazawa Bunko|Kanazawa Library]].

Under the current system, Ranks are conferred posthumously as honors. Recipients often include distinguished [[:en:University|university]] and {{ill|college|ja|短期大学|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/college|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=junior college in Japan|WD=Q110296306}} professors, [[:en:Business manager|business leaders]], {{ill|civil servants|ja|公務員|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/civil servants|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=civil servant|WD=Q212238}}, and notable [[:en:Scholar|scholars]], {{ill|artists|ja|芸術家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/artists|1=artist|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q847689}}, and {{ill|performers|ja|芸能人|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/performers|1=public entertainer|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1899943}} who received awards like the {{ill|Order of the Rising Sun, Gold Rays with Neck Ribbon|ja|旭日中綬章|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Order of the Rising Sun, Gold Rays with Neck Ribbon|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 旭日章|1=Order of the Rising Sun|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q818600}}.

'''Shōgoi''' (正五位) is one of the Ranks in the [[:en:Japan|Japanese]] [[:en:Ritsuryō|Ritsuryō system]] and [[Shinkai (divine rank)|Shinkai (divine Ranks)]]. It is positioned below {{ill|Junior Fourth Rank|ja|従四位|1=Junior Fourth Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fourth Rank|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fourth Rank|qq=}} and above {{ill|Junior Fifth Rank|ja|従五位|1=Junior Fifth Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fifth Rank|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fifth Rank|qq=}}.<ref>https://www.wakapoetry.net/background/society/court-offices-titles-and-Ranks/court-Ranks/</ref> Posthumous Ranks for this level are referred to as ''Zōshōgoi''.

== Overview ==

Shōgoi, under the [[:en:Ritsuryō|Ritsuryō system]], was divided into upper and lower grades. In terms of {{ill|official Ranks|ja|官位|1=East Asian government service ranking|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/official Ranks|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan'i system|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11452076}}, it corresponded primarily to {{ill|Kyōkan|ja|京官|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kyōkan|1=Central officials|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q10883145}} (capitals officers), especially positions such as {{ill|Benkan|ja|弁官|1=benkan|lt=Benkan|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Benkan|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q3270768}} ({{ill|Chūben|ja|左右中弁|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chūben|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} or {{ill|Shōben|ja|少弁|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shōben|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 弁官|1=benkan|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q3270768}}) of the [[:en:Daijō-kan|Daijō-kan]], {{ill|Daibu|ja|大輔|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Daibu|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 日本の官制|1=structure of the ritsuryō government|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q8193883}} of the {{ill|Eight Ministries|ja|八省|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Eight Ministries|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 日本の官制|1=structure of the ritsuryō government|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q8193883}}, {{ill|Ōbanshi|ja|大判事|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōbanshi|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 刑部省|1=Ministry of Justice|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q6867320}}, {{ill|Ōzen-shoku|ja|大膳職|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōzen-shoku|1=Dazai Gon no Daibu|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11438575}} (Ōzen-daibu), [[:en:Major general|Shōshō]] of the {{ill|Konoe Guards|ja|近衛府|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Konoe Guards|1=Konoefu|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11638974}}, and {{ill|Ōkan|ja|衛門府|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōkan|1=Emonfu|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11626338}}. These positions marked the middle-tier bureaucratic status.

In the {{ill|samurai|ja|武家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/samurai|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=buke|WD=Q2927809}} class, the [[:en:Hōjō clan|Hōjō clan]] received this Rank during the [[:en:Kamakura period|Kamakura period]], while it was granted to [[:en:Daimyo|daimyō]] during the [[:en:Toyotomi clan|Toyotomi regime]]. However, during the [[:en:Edo period|Edo period]], appointments to Shōgoi decreased as focus shifted to {{ill|Jūshi'i|ja|従四位|1=Junior Fourth Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jūshi'i|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fourth Rank|qq=}} and {{ill|Jūgoi|ja|従五位|1=Junior Fifth Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jūgoi|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fifth Rank|qq=}}. In this era, the Rank was mainly awarded to {{ill|court officials|ja|宮廷|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/court officials|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 宮殿|1=palace|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q16560}} like {{ill|Chikashōnin|ja|地下官人|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chikashōnin|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 地下人|1=jige officials|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11424047}} serving the [[:en:Royal court|Imperial court]], {{ill|Shinnōke|ja|親王家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shinnōke|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 世襲親王家|1=Seshū Shinnōke|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q848622}}, {{ill|Gosekke|ja|五摂家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gosekke|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 摂家|1=Five regent houses|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1067142}}, and {{ill|Seiga families|ja|清華家|1=Seiga families|2=ja|3=清華家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Seiga families|qq=}}.

From the [[:en:Meiji era|Meiji era]], with the enactment of the {{ill|Rank Grant Ordinance|ja|叙位条例|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Rank Grant Ordinance|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, Ranks above {{ill|Jūshi'i|ja|従四位|1=Junior Fourth Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jūshi'i|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fourth Rank|qq=}} were granted by imperial decree, while Shōgoi and below were conferred by submission (奏授). This Rank often recognized mid-level samurai, [[:en:Military personnel|military officers]], and [[:en:Bureaucrat|bureaucrats]], especially those with notable contributions during the [[:en:Meiji Restoration|Meiji Restoration]]. Historical figures awarded the posthumous Shōgoi include [[:en:Mamiya Rinzō|Mamiya Rinzō]] (granted in [[:en:1904|1904]]) and [[:en:Kanezawa Sanetoki|Hōjō Sanetoki]] (granted in [[:en:1915|1915]]) for cultural accomplishments like founding the [[:en:Kanazawa Bunko|Kanazawa Library]].

Under the current system, Ranks are conferred posthumously as honors. Recipients often include distinguished [[:en:University|university]] and {{ill|college|ja|短期大学|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/college|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=junior college in Japan|WD=Q110296306}} professors, [[:en:Business manager|business leaders]], {{ill|civil servants|ja|公務員|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/civil servants|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=civil servant|WD=Q212238}}, and notable [[:en:Scholar|scholars]], {{ill|artists|ja|芸術家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/artists|1=artist|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q847689}}, and {{ill|performers|ja|芸能人|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/performers|1=public entertainer|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1899943}} who received awards like the {{ill|Order of the Rising Sun, Gold Rays with Neck Ribbon|ja|旭日中綬章|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Order of the Rising Sun, Gold Rays with Neck Ribbon|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 旭日章|1=Order of the Rising Sun|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q818600}}.

== Overview ==

Shōgoi, under the [[:en:Ritsuryō|Ritsuryō system]], was divided into upper and lower grades. In terms of {{ill|official Ranks|ja|官位|1=East Asian government service ranking|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/official Ranks|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan'i system|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11452076}}, it corresponded primarily to {{ill|Kyōkan|ja|京官|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kyōkan|1=Central officials|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q10883145}} (capitals officers), especially positions such as {{ill|Benkan|ja|弁官|1=benkan|lt=Benkan|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Benkan|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q3270768}} ({{ill|Chūben|ja|左右中弁|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chūben|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} or {{ill|Shōben|ja|少弁|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shōben|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 弁官|1=benkan|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q3270768}}) of the [[:en:Daijō-kan|Daijō-kan]], {{ill|Daibu|ja|大輔|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Daibu|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 日本の官制|1=structure of the ritsuryō government|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q8193883}} of the {{ill|Eight Ministries|ja|八省|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Eight Ministries|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 日本の官制|1=structure of the ritsuryō government|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q8193883}}, {{ill|Ōbanshi|ja|大判事|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōbanshi|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 刑部省|1=Ministry of Justice|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q6867320}}, {{ill|Ōzen-shoku|ja|大膳職|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōzen-shoku|1=Dazai Gon no Daibu|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11438575}} (Ōzen-daibu), [[:en:Major general|Shōshō]] of the {{ill|Konoe Guards|ja|近衛府|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Konoe Guards|1=Konoefu|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11638974}}, and {{ill|Ōkan|ja|衛門府|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōkan|1=Emonfu|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11626338}}. These positions marked the middle-tier bureaucratic status.

In the {{ill|samurai|ja|武家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/samurai|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=buke|WD=Q2927809}} class, the [[:en:Hōjō clan|Hōjō clan]] received this Rank during the [[:en:Kamakura period|Kamakura period]], while it was granted to [[:en:Daimyo|daimyō]] during the [[:en:Toyotomi clan|Toyotomi regime]]. However, during the [[:en:Edo period|Edo period]], appointments to Shōgoi decreased as focus shifted to {{ill|Jūshi'i|ja|従四位|1=Junior Fourth Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jūshi'i|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fourth Rank|qq=}} and {{ill|Jūgoi|ja|従五位|1=Junior Fifth Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jūgoi|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fifth Rank|qq=}}. In this era, the Rank was mainly awarded to {{ill|court officials|ja|宮廷|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/court officials|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 宮殿|1=palace|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q16560}} like {{ill|Chikashōnin|ja|地下官人|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chikashōnin|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 地下人|1=jige officials|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11424047}} serving the [[:en:Royal court|Imperial court]], {{ill|Shinnōke|ja|親王家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shinnōke|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 世襲親王家|1=Seshū Shinnōke|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q848622}}, {{ill|Gosekke|ja|五摂家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gosekke|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 摂家|1=Five regent houses|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1067142}}, and {{ill|Seiga families|ja|清華家|1=Seiga families|2=ja|3=清華家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Seiga families|qq=}}.

From the [[:en:Meiji era|Meiji era]], with the enactment of the {{ill|Rank Grant Ordinance|ja|叙位条例|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Rank Grant Ordinance|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, Ranks above {{ill|Jūshi'i|ja|従四位|1=Junior Fourth Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jūshi'i|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fourth Rank|qq=}} were granted by imperial decree, while Shōgoi and below were conferred by submission (奏授). This Rank often recognized mid-level samurai, [[:en:Military personnel|military officers]], and [[:en:Bureaucrat|bureaucrats]], especially those with notable contributions during the [[:en:Meiji Restoration|Meiji Restoration]]. Historical figures awarded the posthumous Shōgoi include [[:en:Mamiya Rinzō|Mamiya Rinzō]] (granted in [[:en:1904|1904]]) and [[:en:Kanezawa Sanetoki|Hōjō Sanetoki]] (granted in [[:en:1915|1915]]) for cultural accomplishments like founding the [[:en:Kanazawa Bunko|Kanazawa Library]].

Under the current system, Ranks are conferred posthumously as honors. Recipients often include distinguished [[:en:University|university]] and {{ill|college|ja|短期大学|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/college|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=junior college in Japan|WD=Q110296306}} professors, [[:en:Business manager|business leaders]], {{ill|civil servants|ja|公務員|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/civil servants|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=civil servant|WD=Q212238}}, and notable [[:en:Scholar|scholars]], {{ill|artists|ja|芸術家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/artists|1=artist|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q847689}}, and {{ill|performers|ja|芸能人|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/performers|1=public entertainer|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1899943}} who received awards like the {{ill|Order of the Rising Sun, Gold Rays with Neck Ribbon|ja|旭日中綬章|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Order of the Rising Sun, Gold Rays with Neck Ribbon|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 旭日章|1=Order of the Rising Sun|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q818600}}.

<!--interwikis from wikidata-->[[ja:正五位]][[ko:정5위]][[zh:正五位]] <!--interwikis from wikidata-->[[ja:正五位]][[ko:정5위]][[zh:正五位]] <!--interwikis from wikidata-->[[ja:正五位]][[ko:정5위]][[zh:正五位]] {{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[da:d:Q11123280]] Wikidata name: Senior Fifth Rank [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 09:11, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{Referencesの明記|date=2015th year 8月}} '''Shōgoi''' (正五位) is one of the Ranks in the [[:en:Japan|Japanese]] [[:en:Ritsuryō|Ritsuryō system]] and [[Shinkai (divine rank)|Shinkai (divine Ranks)]]. It is positioned below {{ill|Junior Fourth Rank|ja|従四位|1=Junior Fourth Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fourth Rank|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fourth Rank|qq=}} and above {{ill|Junior Fifth Rank|ja|従五位|1=Junior Fifth Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fifth Rank|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fifth Rank|qq=}}.<ref>https://www.wakapoetry.net/background/society/court-offices-titles-and-Ranks/court-Ranks/</ref> Posthumous Ranks for this level are referred to as ''Zōshōgoi''.
== Overview ==
Shōgoi, under the [[:en:Ritsuryō|Ritsuryō system]], was divided into upper and lower grades. In terms of {{ill|official Ranks|ja|官位|1=East Asian government service ranking|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/official Ranks|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan'i system|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11452076}}, it corresponded primarily to {{ill|Kyōkan|ja|京官|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kyōkan|1=Central officials|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q10883145}} (capitals officers), especially positions such as {{ill|Benkan|ja|弁官|1=benkan|lt=Benkan|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Benkan|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q3270768}} ({{ill|Chūben|ja|左右中弁|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chūben|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} or {{ill|Shōben|ja|少弁|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shōben|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 弁官|1=benkan|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q3270768}}) of the [[:en:Daijō-kan|Daijō-kan]], {{ill|Daibu|ja|大輔|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Daibu|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 日本の官制|1=structure of the ritsuryō government|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q8193883}} of the {{ill|Eight Ministries|ja|八省|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Eight Ministries|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 日本の官制|1=structure of the ritsuryō government|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q8193883}}, {{ill|Ōbanshi|ja|大判事|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōbanshi|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 刑部省|1=Ministry of Justice|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q6867320}}, {{ill|Ōzen-shoku|ja|大膳職|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōzen-shoku|1=Dazai Gon no Daibu|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11438575}} (Ōzen-daibu), [[:en:Major general|Shōshō]] of the {{ill|Konoe Guards|ja|近衛府|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Konoe Guards|1=Konoefu|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11638974}}, and {{ill|Ōkan|ja|衛門府|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōkan|1=Emonfu|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11626338}}. These positions marked the middle-tier bureaucratic status.
In the {{ill|samurai|ja|武家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/samurai|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=buke|WD=Q2927809}} class, the [[:en:Hōjō clan|Hōjō clan]] received this Rank during the [[:en:Kamakura period|Kamakura period]], while it was granted to [[:en:Daimyo|daimyō]] during the [[:en:Toyotomi clan|Toyotomi regime]]. However, during the [[:en:Edo period|Edo period]], appointments to Shōgoi decreased as focus shifted to {{ill|Jūshi'i|ja|従四位|1=Junior Fourth Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jūshi'i|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fourth Rank|qq=}} and {{ill|Jūgoi|ja|従五位|1=Junior Fifth Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jūgoi|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fifth Rank|qq=}}. In this era, the Rank was mainly awarded to {{ill|court officials|ja|宮廷|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/court officials|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 宮殿|1=palace|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q16560}} like {{ill|Chikashōnin|ja|地下官人|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chikashōnin|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 地下人|1=jige officials|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11424047}} serving the [[:en:Royal court|Imperial court]], {{ill|Shinnōke|ja|親王家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shinnōke|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 世襲親王家|1=Seshū Shinnōke|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q848622}}, {{ill|Gosekke|ja|五摂家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gosekke|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 摂家|1=Five regent houses|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1067142}}, and {{ill|Seiga families|ja|清華家|1=Seiga families|2=ja|3=清華家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Seiga families|qq=}}.
From the [[:en:Meiji era|Meiji era]], with the enactment of the {{ill|Rank Grant Ordinance|ja|叙位条例|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Rank Grant Ordinance|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, Ranks above {{ill|Jūshi'i|ja|従四位|1=Junior Fourth Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jūshi'i|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fourth Rank|qq=}} were granted by imperial decree, while Shōgoi and below were conferred by submission (奏授). This Rank often recognized mid-level samurai, [[:en:Military personnel|military officers]], and [[:en:Bureaucrat|bureaucrats]], especially those with notable contributions during the [[:en:Meiji Restoration|Meiji Restoration]]. Historical figures awarded the posthumous Shōgoi include [[:en:Mamiya Rinzō|Mamiya Rinzō]] (granted in [[:en:1904|1904]]) and [[:en:Kanezawa Sanetoki|Hōjō Sanetoki]] (granted in [[:en:1915|1915]]) for cultural accomplishments like founding the [[:en:Kanazawa Bunko|Kanazawa Library]].
Under the current system, Ranks are conferred posthumously as honors. Recipients often include distinguished [[:en:University|university]] and {{ill|college|ja|短期大学|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/college|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=junior college in Japan|WD=Q110296306}} professors, [[:en:Business manager|business leaders]], {{ill|civil servants|ja|公務員|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/civil servants|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=civil servant|WD=Q212238}}, and notable [[:en:Scholar|scholars]], {{ill|artists|ja|芸術家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/artists|1=artist|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q847689}}, and {{ill|performers|ja|芸能人|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/performers|1=public entertainer|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1899943}} who received awards like the {{ill|Order of the Rising Sun, Gold Rays with Neck Ribbon|ja|旭日中綬章|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Order of the Rising Sun, Gold Rays with Neck Ribbon|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 旭日章|1=Order of the Rising Sun|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q818600}}.
== Recipients of Posthumous Shōgoi (Zōshōgoi) After the Meiji Restoration == * [[:en:1882|1882]] (Meiji 15), June 3<ref>『贈位諸賢伝 増補版 上』特旨贈位年表 p.2</ref> ''' [[:en:Hayashi Shihei|Hayashi Shihei]], [[:en:Satō Nobuhiro|Satō Nobuhiro]] * [[:en:1883|1883]] (Meiji 16), August 6<ref name="zoui3">『贈位諸賢伝 増補版 上』特旨贈位年表 p.3</ref> - {{ill|Sakurayama Chikatoshi|ja|桜山茲俊|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sakurayama Chikatoshi|1=Sakurayama Koretoshi|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11537982}} * ... == See Also == * [[:en:Taifu|Daiō]] * {{ill|Uji Rank system|ja|氏爵|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Uji Rank system|1=Uji Rank system|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11547816}} * {{ill|Annual Rank system|ja|年爵|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Annual Rank system|1=nenshaku|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11483866}} * {{ill|Honorary Ranks|ja|栄爵|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Honorary Ranks|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 叙爵|1=Honorary Ranks|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11410718}} * {{ill|巡爵|ja|巡爵|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/巡爵|1=巡爵|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11479405}} * [[:en:Black-crowned night heron|Black-crowned night heron]] – A [[:en:Heian period|Heian period]] anecdote where a [[:en:Emperor Daigo|Daigo Tennō]]’s decree elevated a captured bird to Shōgoi.
