'''Shōgoi''' (正五位) is one of the Ranks in the {{ill|Japan|en|Japan|WD=Q17|lt=Japanese}} {{ill|Ritsuryō|en|Ritsuryō|WD=Q742460|lt=Ritsuryō system}} and [[Shinkai (divine rank)|Shinkai (divine Ranks)]]. It is positioned below {{ill|Junior Fourth Rank|ja|従四位|1=Junior Fourth Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fourth Rank|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fourth Rank|qq=}} and above {{ill|Junior Fifth Rank|ja|従五位|1=Junior Fifth Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fifth Rank|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fifth Rank|qq=}}.<ref>https://www.wakapoetry.net/background/society/court-offices-titles-and-Ranks/court-Ranks/</ref> Posthumous Ranks for this level are referred to as ''Zōshōgoi''.

== Overview ==

Shōgoi, under the {{ill|Ritsuryō|en|Ritsuryō|WD=Q742460|lt=Ritsuryō system}}, was divided into upper and lower grades. In terms of {{ill|official Ranks|ja|官位|1=East Asian government service ranking|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/official Ranks|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan'i system|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11452076}}, it corresponded primarily to {{ill|Kyōkan|ja|京官|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kyōkan|1=Central officials|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q10883145}} (capitals officers), especially positions such as {{ill|Benkan|ja|弁官|1=benkan|lt=Benkan|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Benkan|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q3270768}} ({{ill|Chūben|ja|左右中弁|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chūben|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} or {{ill|Shōben|ja|少弁|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shōben|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 弁官|1=benkan|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q3270768}}) of the {{ill|Daijō-kan|en|Daijō-kan|WD=Q1192939|lt=Daijō-kan}}, {{ill|Daibu|ja|大輔|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Daibu|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 日本の官制|1=structure of the ritsuryō government|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q8193883}} of the {{ill|Eight Ministries|ja|八省|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Eight Ministries|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 日本の官制|1=structure of the ritsuryō government|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q8193883}}, {{ill|Ōbanshi|ja|大判事|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōbanshi|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 刑部省|1=Ministry of Justice|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q6867320}}, {{ill|Ōzen-shoku|ja|大膳職|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōzen-shoku|1=Dazai Gon no Daibu|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11438575}} (Ōzen-daibu), {{ill|Major general|en|Major general|WD=Q157148|lt=Shōshō}} of the {{ill|Konoe Guards|ja|近衛府|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Konoe Guards|1=Konoefu|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11638974}}, and {{ill|Ōkan|ja|衛門府|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōkan|1=Emonfu|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11626338}}. These positions marked the middle-tier bureaucratic status.

In the {{ill|samurai|ja|武家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/samurai|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=buke|WD=Q2927809}} class, the {{ill|Hōjō clan|en|Hōjō clan|WD=Q834364|lt=Hōjō clan}} received this Rank during the {{ill|Kamakura period|en|Kamakura period|WD=Q236205|lt=Kamakura period}}, while it was granted to {{ill|Daimyo|en|Daimyo|WD=Q61982|lt=daimyō}} during the {{ill|Toyotomi clan|en|Toyotomi clan|WD=Q1521658|lt=Toyotomi regime}}. However, during the {{ill|Edo period|en|Edo period|WD=Q184963|lt=Edo period}}, appointments to Shōgoi decreased as focus shifted to {{ill|Jūshi'i|ja|従四位|1=Junior Fourth Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jūshi'i|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fourth Rank|qq=}} and {{ill|Jūgoi|ja|従五位|1=Junior Fifth Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jūgoi|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fifth Rank|qq=}}. In this era, the Rank was mainly awarded to {{ill|court officials|ja|宮廷|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/court officials|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 宮殿|1=palace|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q16560}} like {{ill|Chikashōnin|ja|地下官人|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chikashōnin|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 地下人|1=jige officials|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11424047}} serving the {{ill|Royal court|en|Royal court|WD=Q1134237|lt=Imperial court}}, {{ill|Shinnōke|ja|親王家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shinnōke|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 世襲親王家|1=Seshū Shinnōke|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q848622}}, {{ill|Gosekke|ja|五摂家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gosekke|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 摂家|1=Five regent houses|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1067142}}, and {{ill|Seiga families|ja|清華家|1=Seiga families|2=ja|3=清華家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Seiga families|qq=}}.

From the {{ill|Meiji era|en|Meiji era|WD=Q3125096|lt=Meiji era}}, with the enactment of the {{ill|Rank Grant Ordinance|ja|叙位条例|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Rank Grant Ordinance|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, Ranks above {{ill|Jūshi'i|ja|従四位|1=Junior Fourth Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jūshi'i|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fourth Rank|qq=}} were granted by imperial decree, while Shōgoi and below were conferred by submission (奏授). This Rank often recognized mid-level samurai, {{ill|Military personnel|en|Military personnel|WD=Q47064|lt=military officers}}, and {{ill|Bureaucrat|en|Bureaucrat|WD=Q572700|lt=bureaucrats}}, especially those with notable contributions during the {{ill|Meiji Restoration|en|Meiji Restoration|WD=Q8707|lt=Meiji Restoration}}. Historical figures awarded the posthumous Shōgoi include {{ill|Mamiya Rinzō|en|Mamiya Rinzō|WD=Q952891|lt=Mamiya Rinzō}} (granted in {{ill|1904|en|1904|WD=Q2046|lt=1904}}) and {{ill|Kanezawa Sanetoki|en|Kanezawa Sanetoki|WD=Q596360|lt=Hōjō Sanetoki}} (granted in {{ill|1915|en|1915|WD=Q2084|lt=1915}}) for cultural accomplishments like founding the {{ill|Kanazawa Bunko|en|Kanazawa Bunko|WD=Q3192586|lt=Kanazawa Library}}.

Under the current system, Ranks are conferred posthumously as honors. Recipients often include distinguished {{ill|University|en|University|WD=Q3918|lt=university}} and {{ill|college|ja|短期大学|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/college|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=junior college in Japan|WD=Q110296306}} professors, {{ill|Business manager|en|Business manager|WD=Q832136|lt=business leaders}}, {{ill|civil servants|ja|公務員|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/civil servants|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=civil servant|WD=Q212238}}, and notable {{ill|Scholar|en|Scholar|WD=Q20826540|lt=scholars}}, {{ill|artists|ja|芸術家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/artists|1=artist|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q847689}}, and {{ill|performers|ja|芸能人|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/performers|1=public entertainer|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1899943}} who received awards like the {{ill|Order of the Rising Sun, Gold Rays with Neck Ribbon|ja|旭日中綬章|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Order of the Rising Sun, Gold Rays with Neck Ribbon|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 旭日章|1=Order of the Rising Sun|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q818600}}.

'''Shōgoi''' (正五位) is one of the Ranks in the {{ill|Japan|en|Japan|WD=Q17|lt=Japanese}} {{ill|Ritsuryō|en|Ritsuryō|WD=Q742460|lt=Ritsuryō system}} and [[Shinkai (divine rank)|Shinkai (divine Ranks)]]. It is positioned below {{ill|Junior Fourth Rank|ja|従四位|1=Junior Fourth Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fourth Rank|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fourth Rank|qq=}} and above {{ill|Junior Fifth Rank|ja|従五位|1=Junior Fifth Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fifth Rank|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fifth Rank|qq=}}.<ref>https://www.wakapoetry.net/background/society/court-offices-titles-and-Ranks/court-Ranks/</ref> Posthumous Ranks for this level are referred to as ''Zōshōgoi''.

== Overview ==

Shōgoi, under the {{ill|Ritsuryō|en|Ritsuryō|WD=Q742460|lt=Ritsuryō system}}, was divided into upper and lower grades. In terms of {{ill|official Ranks|ja|官位|1=East Asian government service ranking|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/official Ranks|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan'i system|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11452076}}, it corresponded primarily to {{ill|Kyōkan|ja|京官|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kyōkan|1=Central officials|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q10883145}} (capitals officers), especially positions such as {{ill|Benkan|ja|弁官|1=benkan|lt=Benkan|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Benkan|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q3270768}} ({{ill|Chūben|ja|左右中弁|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chūben|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} or {{ill|Shōben|ja|少弁|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shōben|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 弁官|1=benkan|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q3270768}}) of the {{ill|Daijō-kan|en|Daijō-kan|WD=Q1192939|lt=Daijō-kan}}, {{ill|Daibu|ja|大輔|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Daibu|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 日本の官制|1=structure of the ritsuryō government|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q8193883}} of the {{ill|Eight Ministries|ja|八省|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Eight Ministries|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 日本の官制|1=structure of the ritsuryō government|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q8193883}}, {{ill|Ōbanshi|ja|大判事|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōbanshi|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 刑部省|1=Ministry of Justice|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q6867320}}, {{ill|Ōzen-shoku|ja|大膳職|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōzen-shoku|1=Dazai Gon no Daibu|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11438575}} (Ōzen-daibu), {{ill|Major general|en|Major general|WD=Q157148|lt=Shōshō}} of the {{ill|Konoe Guards|ja|近衛府|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Konoe Guards|1=Konoefu|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11638974}}, and {{ill|Ōkan|ja|衛門府|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōkan|1=Emonfu|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11626338}}. These positions marked the middle-tier bureaucratic status.

In the {{ill|samurai|ja|武家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/samurai|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=buke|WD=Q2927809}} class, the {{ill|Hōjō clan|en|Hōjō clan|WD=Q834364|lt=Hōjō clan}} received this Rank during the {{ill|Kamakura period|en|Kamakura period|WD=Q236205|lt=Kamakura period}}, while it was granted to {{ill|Daimyo|en|Daimyo|WD=Q61982|lt=daimyō}} during the {{ill|Toyotomi clan|en|Toyotomi clan|WD=Q1521658|lt=Toyotomi regime}}. However, during the {{ill|Edo period|en|Edo period|WD=Q184963|lt=Edo period}}, appointments to Shōgoi decreased as focus shifted to {{ill|Jūshi'i|ja|従四位|1=Junior Fourth Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jūshi'i|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fourth Rank|qq=}} and {{ill|Jūgoi|ja|従五位|1=Junior Fifth Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jūgoi|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fifth Rank|qq=}}. In this era, the Rank was mainly awarded to {{ill|court officials|ja|宮廷|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/court officials|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 宮殿|1=palace|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q16560}} like {{ill|Chikashōnin|ja|地下官人|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chikashōnin|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 地下人|1=jige officials|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11424047}} serving the {{ill|Royal court|en|Royal court|WD=Q1134237|lt=Imperial court}}, {{ill|Shinnōke|ja|親王家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shinnōke|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 世襲親王家|1=Seshū Shinnōke|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q848622}}, {{ill|Gosekke|ja|五摂家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gosekke|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 摂家|1=Five regent houses|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1067142}}, and {{ill|Seiga families|ja|清華家|1=Seiga families|2=ja|3=清華家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Seiga families|qq=}}.

From the {{ill|Meiji era|en|Meiji era|WD=Q3125096|lt=Meiji era}}, with the enactment of the {{ill|Rank Grant Ordinance|ja|叙位条例|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Rank Grant Ordinance|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, Ranks above {{ill|Jūshi'i|ja|従四位|1=Junior Fourth Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jūshi'i|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fourth Rank|qq=}} were granted by imperial decree, while Shōgoi and below were conferred by submission (奏授). This Rank often recognized mid-level samurai, {{ill|Military personnel|en|Military personnel|WD=Q47064|lt=military officers}}, and {{ill|Bureaucrat|en|Bureaucrat|WD=Q572700|lt=bureaucrats}}, especially those with notable contributions during the {{ill|Meiji Restoration|en|Meiji Restoration|WD=Q8707|lt=Meiji Restoration}}. Historical figures awarded the posthumous Shōgoi include {{ill|Mamiya Rinzō|en|Mamiya Rinzō|WD=Q952891|lt=Mamiya Rinzō}} (granted in {{ill|1904|en|1904|WD=Q2046|lt=1904}}) and {{ill|Kanezawa Sanetoki|en|Kanezawa Sanetoki|WD=Q596360|lt=Hōjō Sanetoki}} (granted in {{ill|1915|en|1915|WD=Q2084|lt=1915}}) for cultural accomplishments like founding the {{ill|Kanazawa Bunko|en|Kanazawa Bunko|WD=Q3192586|lt=Kanazawa Library}}.

Under the current system, Ranks are conferred posthumously as honors. Recipients often include distinguished {{ill|University|en|University|WD=Q3918|lt=university}} and {{ill|college|ja|短期大学|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/college|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=junior college in Japan|WD=Q110296306}} professors, {{ill|Business manager|en|Business manager|WD=Q832136|lt=business leaders}}, {{ill|civil servants|ja|公務員|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/civil servants|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=civil servant|WD=Q212238}}, and notable {{ill|Scholar|en|Scholar|WD=Q20826540|lt=scholars}}, {{ill|artists|ja|芸術家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/artists|1=artist|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q847689}}, and {{ill|performers|ja|芸能人|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/performers|1=public entertainer|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1899943}} who received awards like the {{ill|Order of the Rising Sun, Gold Rays with Neck Ribbon|ja|旭日中綬章|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Order of the Rising Sun, Gold Rays with Neck Ribbon|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 旭日章|1=Order of the Rising Sun|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q818600}}.

'''Shōgoi''' (正五位) is one of the Ranks in the {{ill|Japan|en|Japan|WD=Q17|lt=Japanese}} {{ill|Ritsuryō|en|Ritsuryō|WD=Q742460|lt=Ritsuryō system}} and [[Shinkai (divine rank)|Shinkai (divine Ranks)]]. It is positioned below {{ill|Junior Fourth Rank|ja|従四位|1=Junior Fourth Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fourth Rank|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fourth Rank|qq=}} and above {{ill|Junior Fifth Rank|ja|従五位|1=Junior Fifth Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fifth Rank|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fifth Rank|qq=}}.<ref>https://www.wakapoetry.net/background/society/court-offices-titles-and-Ranks/court-Ranks/</ref> Posthumous Ranks for this level are referred to as ''Zōshōgoi''.

== Overview ==

Shōgoi, under the {{ill|Ritsuryō|en|Ritsuryō|WD=Q742460|lt=Ritsuryō system}}, was divided into upper and lower grades. In terms of {{ill|official Ranks|ja|官位|1=East Asian government service ranking|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/official Ranks|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan'i system|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11452076}}, it corresponded primarily to {{ill|Kyōkan|ja|京官|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kyōkan|1=Central officials|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q10883145}} (capitals officers), especially positions such as {{ill|Benkan|ja|弁官|1=benkan|lt=Benkan|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Benkan|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q3270768}} ({{ill|Chūben|ja|左右中弁|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chūben|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} or {{ill|Shōben|ja|少弁|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shōben|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 弁官|1=benkan|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q3270768}}) of the {{ill|Daijō-kan|en|Daijō-kan|WD=Q1192939|lt=Daijō-kan}}, {{ill|Daibu|ja|大輔|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Daibu|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 日本の官制|1=structure of the ritsuryō government|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q8193883}} of the {{ill|Eight Ministries|ja|八省|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Eight Ministries|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 日本の官制|1=structure of the ritsuryō government|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q8193883}}, {{ill|Ōbanshi|ja|大判事|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōbanshi|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 刑部省|1=Ministry of Justice|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q6867320}}, {{ill|Ōzen-shoku|ja|大膳職|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōzen-shoku|1=Dazai Gon no Daibu|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11438575}} (Ōzen-daibu), {{ill|Major general|en|Major general|WD=Q157148|lt=Shōshō}} of the {{ill|Konoe Guards|ja|近衛府|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Konoe Guards|1=Konoefu|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11638974}}, and {{ill|Ōkan|ja|衛門府|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōkan|1=Emonfu|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11626338}}. These positions marked the middle-tier bureaucratic status.

In the {{ill|samurai|ja|武家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/samurai|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=buke|WD=Q2927809}} class, the {{ill|Hōjō clan|en|Hōjō clan|WD=Q834364|lt=Hōjō clan}} received this Rank during the {{ill|Kamakura period|en|Kamakura period|WD=Q236205|lt=Kamakura period}}, while it was granted to {{ill|Daimyo|en|Daimyo|WD=Q61982|lt=daimyō}} during the {{ill|Toyotomi clan|en|Toyotomi clan|WD=Q1521658|lt=Toyotomi regime}}. However, during the {{ill|Edo period|en|Edo period|WD=Q184963|lt=Edo period}}, appointments to Shōgoi decreased as focus shifted to {{ill|Jūshi'i|ja|従四位|1=Junior Fourth Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jūshi'i|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fourth Rank|qq=}} and {{ill|Jūgoi|ja|従五位|1=Junior Fifth Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jūgoi|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fifth Rank|qq=}}. In this era, the Rank was mainly awarded to {{ill|court officials|ja|宮廷|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/court officials|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 宮殿|1=palace|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q16560}} like {{ill|Chikashōnin|ja|地下官人|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chikashōnin|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 地下人|1=jige officials|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11424047}} serving the {{ill|Royal court|en|Royal court|WD=Q1134237|lt=Imperial court}}, {{ill|Shinnōke|ja|親王家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shinnōke|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 世襲親王家|1=Seshū Shinnōke|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q848622}}, {{ill|Gosekke|ja|五摂家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gosekke|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 摂家|1=Five regent houses|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1067142}}, and {{ill|Seiga families|ja|清華家|1=Seiga families|2=ja|3=清華家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Seiga families|qq=}}.

From the {{ill|Meiji era|en|Meiji era|WD=Q3125096|lt=Meiji era}}, with the enactment of the {{ill|Rank Grant Ordinance|ja|叙位条例|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Rank Grant Ordinance|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, Ranks above {{ill|Jūshi'i|ja|従四位|1=Junior Fourth Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jūshi'i|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fourth Rank|qq=}} were granted by imperial decree, while Shōgoi and below were conferred by submission (奏授). This Rank often recognized mid-level samurai, {{ill|Military personnel|en|Military personnel|WD=Q47064|lt=military officers}}, and {{ill|Bureaucrat|en|Bureaucrat|WD=Q572700|lt=bureaucrats}}, especially those with notable contributions during the {{ill|Meiji Restoration|en|Meiji Restoration|WD=Q8707|lt=Meiji Restoration}}. Historical figures awarded the posthumous Shōgoi include {{ill|Mamiya Rinzō|en|Mamiya Rinzō|WD=Q952891|lt=Mamiya Rinzō}} (granted in {{ill|1904|en|1904|WD=Q2046|lt=1904}}) and {{ill|Kanezawa Sanetoki|en|Kanezawa Sanetoki|WD=Q596360|lt=Hōjō Sanetoki}} (granted in {{ill|1915|en|1915|WD=Q2084|lt=1915}}) for cultural accomplishments like founding the {{ill|Kanazawa Bunko|en|Kanazawa Bunko|WD=Q3192586|lt=Kanazawa Library}}.

Under the current system, Ranks are conferred posthumously as honors. Recipients often include distinguished {{ill|University|en|University|WD=Q3918|lt=university}} and {{ill|college|ja|短期大学|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/college|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=junior college in Japan|WD=Q110296306}} professors, {{ill|Business manager|en|Business manager|WD=Q832136|lt=business leaders}}, {{ill|civil servants|ja|公務員|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/civil servants|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=civil servant|WD=Q212238}}, and notable {{ill|Scholar|en|Scholar|WD=Q20826540|lt=scholars}}, {{ill|artists|ja|芸術家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/artists|1=artist|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q847689}}, and {{ill|performers|ja|芸能人|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/performers|1=public entertainer|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1899943}} who received awards like the {{ill|Order of the Rising Sun, Gold Rays with Neck Ribbon|ja|旭日中綬章|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Order of the Rising Sun, Gold Rays with Neck Ribbon|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 旭日章|1=Order of the Rising Sun|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q818600}}.

However, during the {{ill|Edo period|en|Edo period|WD=Q184963|lt=Edo period}}, appointments to Shōgoi decreased as focus shifted to {{ill|Jūshi'i|ja|従四位|1=Junior Fourth Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jūshi'i|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fourth Rank|qq=}} and {{ill|Jūgoi|ja|従五位|1=Junior Fifth Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jūgoi|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fifth Rank|qq=}}. In this era, the Rank was mainly awarded to {{ill|court officials|ja|宮廷|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/court officials|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 宮殿|1=palace|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q16560}} like {{ill|Chikashōnin|ja|地下官人|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chikashōnin|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 地下人|1=jige officials|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11424047}} serving the {{ill|Royal court|en|Royal court|WD=Q1134237|lt=Imperial court}}, {{ill|Shinnōke|ja|親王家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shinnōke|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 世襲親王家|1=Seshū Shinnōke|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q848622}}, {{ill|Gosekke|ja|五摂家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gosekke|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 摂家|1=Five regent houses|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1067142}}, and {{ill|Seiga families|ja|清華家|1=Seiga families|2=ja|3=清華家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Seiga families|qq=}}.

From the {{ill|Meiji era|en|Meiji era|WD=Q3125096|lt=Meiji era}}, with the enactment of the {{ill|Rank Grant Ordinance|ja|叙位条例|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Rank Grant Ordinance|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, Ranks above {{ill|Jūshi'i|ja|従四位|1=Junior Fourth Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jūshi'i|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fourth Rank|qq=}} were granted by imperial decree, while Shōgoi and below were conferred by submission (奏授). This Rank often recognized mid-level samurai, {{ill|Military personnel|en|Military personnel|WD=Q47064|lt=military officers}}, and {{ill|Bureaucrat|en|Bureaucrat|WD=Q572700|lt=bureaucrats}}, especially those with notable contributions during the {{ill|Meiji Restoration|en|Meiji Restoration|WD=Q8707|lt=Meiji Restoration}}. Historical figures awarded the posthumous Shōgoi include {{ill|Mamiya Rinzō|en|Mamiya Rinzō|WD=Q952891|lt=Mamiya Rinzō}} (granted in {{ill|1904|en|1904|WD=Q2046|lt=1904}}) and {{ill|Kanezawa Sanetoki|en|Kanezawa Sanetoki|WD=Q596360|lt=Hōjō Sanetoki}} (granted in {{ill|1915|en|1915|WD=Q2084|lt=1915}}) for cultural accomplishments like founding the {{ill|Kanazawa Bunko|en|Kanazawa Bunko|WD=Q3192586|lt=Kanazawa Library}}.

Under the current system, Ranks are conferred posthumously as honors. Recipients often include distinguished {{ill|University|en|University|WD=Q3918|lt=university}} and {{ill|college|ja|短期大学|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/college|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=junior college in Japan|WD=Q110296306}} professors, {{ill|Business manager|en|Business manager|WD=Q832136|lt=business leaders}}, {{ill|civil servants|ja|公務員|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/civil servants|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=civil servant|WD=Q212238}}, and notable {{ill|Scholar|en|Scholar|WD=Q20826540|lt=scholars}}, {{ill|artists|ja|芸術家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/artists|1=artist|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q847689}}, and {{ill|performers|ja|芸能人|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/performers|1=public entertainer|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1899943}} who received awards like the {{ill|Order of the Rising Sun, Gold Rays with Neck Ribbon|ja|旭日中綬章|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Order of the Rising Sun, Gold Rays with Neck Ribbon|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 旭日章|1=Order of the Rising Sun|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q818600}}.

{{Referencesの明記|date=2015th year 8月}}
'''Shōgoi''' (正五位) is one of the Ranks in the {{ill|Japan|en|Japan|WD=Q17|lt=Japanese}} {{ill|Ritsuryō|en|Ritsuryō|WD=Q742460|lt=Ritsuryō system}} and [[Shinkai (divine rank)|Shinkai (divine Ranks)]]. It is positioned below {{ill|Junior Fourth Rank|ja|従四位|1=Junior Fourth Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fourth Rank|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fourth Rank|qq=}} and above {{ill|Junior Fifth Rank|ja|従五位|1=Junior Fifth Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fifth Rank|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fifth Rank|qq=}}.<ref>https://www.wakapoetry.net/background/society/court-offices-titles-and-Ranks/court-Ranks/</ref> Posthumous Ranks for this level are referred to as ''Zōshōgoi''.

== Overview ==

Shōgoi, under the {{ill|Ritsuryō|en|Ritsuryō|WD=Q742460|lt=Ritsuryō system}}, was divided into upper and lower grades. In terms of {{ill|official Ranks|ja|官位|1=East Asian government service ranking|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/official Ranks|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan'i system|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11452076}}, it corresponded primarily to {{ill|Kyōkan|ja|京官|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kyōkan|1=Central officials|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q10883145}} (capitals officers), especially positions such as {{ill|Benkan|ja|弁官|1=benkan|lt=Benkan|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Benkan|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q3270768}} ({{ill|Chūben|ja|左右中弁|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chūben|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} or {{ill|Shōben|ja|少弁|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shōben|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 弁官|1=benkan|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q3270768}}) of the {{ill|Daijō-kan|en|Daijō-kan|WD=Q1192939|lt=Daijō-kan}}, {{ill|Daibu|ja|大輔|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Daibu|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 日本の官制|1=structure of the ritsuryō government|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q8193883}} of the {{ill|Eight Ministries|ja|八省|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Eight Ministries|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 日本の官制|1=structure of the ritsuryō government|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q8193883}}, {{ill|Ōbanshi|ja|大判事|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōbanshi|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 刑部省|1=Ministry of Justice|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q6867320}}, {{ill|Ōzen-shoku|ja|大膳職|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōzen-shoku|1=Dazai Gon no Daibu|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11438575}} (Ōzen-daibu), {{ill|Major general|en|Major general|WD=Q157148|lt=Shōshō}} of the {{ill|Konoe Guards|ja|近衛府|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Konoe Guards|1=Konoefu|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11638974}}, and {{ill|Ōkan|ja|衛門府|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōkan|1=Emonfu|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11626338}}. These positions marked the middle-tier bureaucratic status.

In the {{ill|samurai|ja|武家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/samurai|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=buke|WD=Q2927809}} class, the {{ill|Hōjō clan|en|Hōjō clan|WD=Q834364|lt=Hōjō clan}} received this Rank during the {{ill|Kamakura period|en|Kamakura period|WD=Q236205|lt=Kamakura period}}, while it was granted to {{ill|Daimyo|en|Daimyo|WD=Q61982|lt=daimyō}} during the {{ill|Toyotomi clan|en|Toyotomi clan|WD=Q1521658|lt=Toyotomi regime}}. However, during the {{ill|Edo period|en|Edo period|WD=Q184963|lt=Edo period}}, appointments to Shōgoi decreased as focus shifted to {{ill|Jūshi'i|ja|従四位|1=Junior Fourth Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jūshi'i|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fourth Rank|qq=}} and {{ill|Jūgoi|ja|従五位|1=Junior Fifth Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jūgoi|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fifth Rank|qq=}}. In this era, the Rank was mainly awarded to {{ill|court officials|ja|宮廷|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/court officials|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 宮殿|1=palace|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q16560}} like {{ill|Chikashōnin|ja|地下官人|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chikashōnin|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 地下人|1=jige officials|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11424047}} serving the {{ill|Royal court|en|Royal court|WD=Q1134237|lt=Imperial court}}, {{ill|Shinnōke|ja|親王家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shinnōke|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 世襲親王家|1=Seshū Shinnōke|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q848622}}, {{ill|Gosekke|ja|五摂家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gosekke|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 摂家|1=Five regent houses|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1067142}}, and {{ill|Seiga families|ja|清華家|1=Seiga families|2=ja|3=清華家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Seiga families|qq=}}.

From the {{ill|Meiji era|en|Meiji era|WD=Q3125096|lt=Meiji era}}, with the enactment of the {{ill|Rank Grant Ordinance|ja|叙位条例|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Rank Grant Ordinance|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, Ranks above {{ill|Jūshi'i|ja|従四位|1=Junior Fourth Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jūshi'i|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fourth Rank|qq=}} were granted by imperial decree, while Shōgoi and below were conferred by submission (奏授). This Rank often recognized mid-level samurai, {{ill|Military personnel|en|Military personnel|WD=Q47064|lt=military officers}}, and {{ill|Bureaucrat|en|Bureaucrat|WD=Q572700|lt=bureaucrats}}, especially those with notable contributions during the {{ill|Meiji Restoration|en|Meiji Restoration|WD=Q8707|lt=Meiji Restoration}}. Historical figures awarded the posthumous Shōgoi include {{ill|Mamiya Rinzō|en|Mamiya Rinzō|WD=Q952891|lt=Mamiya Rinzō}} (granted in {{ill|1904|en|1904|WD=Q2046|lt=1904}}) and {{ill|Kanezawa Sanetoki|en|Kanezawa Sanetoki|WD=Q596360|lt=Hōjō Sanetoki}} (granted in {{ill|1915|en|1915|WD=Q2084|lt=1915}}) for cultural accomplishments like founding the {{ill|Kanazawa Bunko|en|Kanazawa Bunko|WD=Q3192586|lt=Kanazawa Library}}.

Under the current system, Ranks are conferred posthumously as honors. Recipients often include distinguished {{ill|University|en|University|WD=Q3918|lt=university}} and {{ill|college|ja|短期大学|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/college|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=junior college in Japan|WD=Q110296306}} professors, {{ill|Business manager|en|Business manager|WD=Q832136|lt=business leaders}}, {{ill|civil servants|ja|公務員|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/civil servants|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=civil servant|WD=Q212238}}, and notable {{ill|Scholar|en|Scholar|WD=Q20826540|lt=scholars}}, {{ill|artists|ja|芸術家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/artists|1=artist|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q847689}}, and {{ill|performers|ja|芸能人|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/performers|1=public entertainer|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1899943}} who received awards like the {{ill|Order of the Rising Sun, Gold Rays with Neck Ribbon|ja|旭日中綬章|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Order of the Rising Sun, Gold Rays with Neck Ribbon|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 旭日章|1=Order of the Rising Sun|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q818600}}.

{{Referencesの明記|date=2015th year 8月}}
'''Shōgoi''' (正五位) is one of the Ranks in the {{ill|Japan|en|Japan|WD=Q17|lt=Japanese|1=Japan}} {{ill|Ritsuryō|en|Ritsuryō|WD=Q742460|lt=Ritsuryō system|1=Ritsuryō}} and [[Shinkai (divine rank)|Shinkai (divine Ranks)]]. It is positioned below {{ill|Junior Fourth Rank|ja|従四位|1=Junior Fourth Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fourth Rank|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fourth Rank|qq=}} and above {{ill|Junior Fifth Rank|ja|従五位|1=Junior Fifth Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fifth Rank|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fifth Rank|qq=}}.<ref>https://www.wakapoetry.net/background/society/court-offices-titles-and-Ranks/court-Ranks/</ref> Posthumous Ranks for this level are referred to as ''Zōshōgoi''.

== Overview ==

Shōgoi, under the {{ill|Ritsuryō|en|Ritsuryō|WD=Q742460|lt=Ritsuryō system|1=Ritsuryō}}, was divided into upper and lower grades. In terms of {{ill|official Ranks|ja|官位|1=East Asian government service ranking|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/official Ranks|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan'i system|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11452076}}, it corresponded primarily to {{ill|Kyōkan|ja|京官|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kyōkan|1=Central officials|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q10883145}} (capitals officers), especially positions such as {{ill|Benkan|ja|弁官|1=benkan|lt=Benkan|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Benkan|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q3270768}} ({{ill|Chūben|ja|左右中弁|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chūben|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} or {{ill|Shōben|ja|少弁|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shōben|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 弁官|1=benkan|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q3270768}}) of the {{ill|Daijō-kan|en|Daijō-kan|WD=Q1192939|lt=Daijō-kan|1=Daijō-kan}}, {{ill|Daibu|ja|大輔|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Daibu|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 日本の官制|1=structure of the ritsuryō government|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q8193883}} of the {{ill|Eight Ministries|ja|八省|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Eight Ministries|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 日本の官制|1=structure of the ritsuryō government|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q8193883}}, {{ill|Ōbanshi|ja|大判事|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōbanshi|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 刑部省|1=Ministry of Justice (pre-modern Japan)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q6867320}}, {{ill|Ōzen-shoku|ja|大膳職|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōzen-shoku|1=Dazai Gon no Daibu|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11438575}} (Ōzen-daibu), {{ill|Major general|en|Major general|WD=Q157148|lt=Shōshō|1=Major general}} of the {{ill|Konoe Guards|ja|近衛府|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Konoe Guards|1=Konoefu|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11638974}}, and {{ill|Ōkan|ja|衛門府|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōkan|1=Emonfu|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11626338}}. These positions marked the middle-tier bureaucratic status.

In the {{ill|samurai|ja|武家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/samurai|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=Buke|WD=Q2927809}} class, the {{ill|Hōjō clan|en|Hōjō clan|WD=Q834364|lt=Hōjō clan|1=Hōjō clan}} received this Rank during the {{ill|Kamakura period|en|Kamakura period|WD=Q236205|lt=Kamakura period|1=Kamakura period}}, while it was granted to {{ill|Daimyo|en|Daimyo|WD=Q61982|lt=daimyō|1=Daimyo}} during the {{ill|Toyotomi clan|en|Toyotomi clan|WD=Q1521658|lt=Toyotomi regime|1=Toyotomi clan}}. However, during the {{ill|Edo period|en|Edo period|WD=Q184963|lt=Edo period|1=Edo period}}, appointments to Shōgoi decreased as focus shifted to {{ill|Jūshi'i|ja|従四位|1=Junior Fourth Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jūshi'i|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fourth Rank|qq=}} and {{ill|Jūgoi|ja|従五位|1=Junior Fifth Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jūgoi|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fifth Rank|qq=}}. In this era, the Rank was mainly awarded to {{ill|court officials|ja|宮廷|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/court officials|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 宮殿|1=Palace|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q16560}} like {{ill|Chikashōnin|ja|地下官人|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chikashōnin|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 地下人|1=jige officials|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11424047}} serving the {{ill|Royal court|en|Royal court|WD=Q1134237|lt=Imperial court|1=Royal court}}, {{ill|Shinnōke|ja|親王家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shinnōke|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 世襲親王家|1=Shinnōke|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q848622}}, {{ill|Gosekke|ja|五摂家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gosekke|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 摂家|1=Five regent houses|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1067142}}, and {{ill|Seiga families|ja|清華家|1=Seiga families|2=ja|3=清華家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Seiga families|qq=}}.

From the {{ill|Meiji era|en|Meiji era|WD=Q3125096|lt=Meiji era|1=Meiji era}}, with the enactment of the {{ill|Rank Grant Ordinance|ja|叙位条例|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Rank Grant Ordinance|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, Ranks above {{ill|Jūshi'i|ja|従四位|1=Junior Fourth Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jūshi'i|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fourth Rank|qq=}} were granted by imperial decree, while Shōgoi and below were conferred by submission (奏授). This Rank often recognized mid-level samurai, {{ill|Military personnel|en|Military personnel|WD=Q47064|lt=military officers|1=Military personnel}}, and {{ill|Bureaucrat|en|Bureaucrat|WD=Q572700|lt=bureaucrats|1=Bureaucrat}}, especially those with notable contributions during the {{ill|Meiji Restoration|en|Meiji Restoration|WD=Q8707|lt=Meiji Restoration|1=Meiji Restoration}}. Historical figures awarded the posthumous Shōgoi include {{ill|Mamiya Rinzō|en|Mamiya Rinzō|WD=Q952891|lt=Mamiya Rinzō|1=Mamiya Rinzō}} (granted in {{ill|1904|en|1904|WD=Q2046|lt=1904|1=1904}}) and {{ill|Kanezawa Sanetoki|en|Kanezawa Sanetoki|WD=Q596360|lt=Hōjō Sanetoki|1=Kanezawa Sanetoki}} (granted in {{ill|1915|en|1915|WD=Q2084|lt=1915|1=1915}}) for cultural accomplishments like founding the {{ill|Kanazawa Bunko|en|Kanazawa Bunko|WD=Q3192586|lt=Kanazawa Library|1=Kanazawa Bunko}}.

Under the current system, Ranks are conferred posthumously as honors. Recipients often include distinguished {{ill|University|en|University|WD=Q3918|lt=university|1=University}} and {{ill|college|ja|短期大学|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/college|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=Junior colleges in Japan|WD=Q110296306}} professors, {{ill|Business manager|en|Business manager|WD=Q832136|lt=business leaders|1=Business manager}}, {{ill|civil servants|ja|公務員|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/civil servants|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=Civil servant|WD=Q212238}}, and notable {{ill|Scholar|en|Scholar|WD=Q20826540|lt=scholars|1=Scholar}}, {{ill|artists|ja|芸術家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/artists|1=artist|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q847689}}, and {{ill|performers|ja|芸能人|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/performers|1=public entertainer|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1899943}} who received awards like the {{ill|Order of the Rising Sun, Gold Rays with Neck Ribbon|ja|旭日中綬章|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Order of the Rising Sun, Gold Rays with Neck Ribbon|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 旭日章|1=Order of the Rising Sun|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q818600}}.

In the {{ill|samurai|ja|武家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/samurai|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=Buke|WD=Q2927809}} class, the {{ill|Hōjō clan|en|Hōjō clan|WD=Q834364|lt=Hōjō clan|1=Hōjō clan}} received this Rank during the {{ill|Kamakura period|en|Kamakura period|WD=Q236205|lt=Kamakura period|1=Kamakura period}}, while it was granted to {{ill|Daimyo|en|Daimyo|WD=Q61982|lt=daimyō|1=Daimyo}} during the {{ill|Toyotomi clan|en|Toyotomi clan|WD=Q1521658|lt=Toyotomi regime|1=Toyotomi clan}}. However, during the {{ill|Edo period|en|Edo period|WD=Q184963|lt=Edo period|1=Edo period}}, appointments to Shōgoi decreased as focus shifted to {{ill|Jūshi'i|ja|従四位|1=Junior Fourth Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jūshi'i|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fourth Rank|qq=}} and {{ill|Jūgoi|ja|従五位|1=Junior Fifth Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jūgoi|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fifth Rank|qq=}}. In this era, the Rank was mainly awarded to {{ill|court officials|ja|宮廷|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/court officials|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 宮殿|1=Palace|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q16560}} like {{ill|Chikashōnin|ja|地下官人|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chikashōnin|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 地下人|1=jige officials|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11424047}} serving the {{ill|Royal court|en|Royal court|WD=Q1134237|lt=Imperial court|1=Royal court}}, {{ill|Shinnōke|ja|親王家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shinnōke|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 世襲親王家|1=Shinnōke|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q848622}}, {{ill|Gosekke|ja|五摂家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gosekke|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 摂家|1=Five regent houses|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1067142}}, and {{ill|Seiga families|ja|清華家|1=Seiga families|2=ja|3=清華家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Seiga families|qq=}}.

From the {{ill|Meiji era|en|Meiji era|WD=Q3125096|lt=Meiji era|1=Meiji era}}, with the enactment of the {{ill|Rank Grant Ordinance|ja|叙位条例|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Rank Grant Ordinance|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, Ranks above {{ill|Jūshi'i|ja|従四位|1=Junior Fourth Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jūshi'i|13=User:Immanuelle/Junior Fourth Rank|qq=}} were granted by imperial decree, while Shōgoi and below were conferred by submission (奏授). This Rank often recognized mid-level samurai, {{ill|Military personnel|en|Military personnel|WD=Q47064|lt=military officers|1=Military personnel}}, and {{ill|Bureaucrat|en|Bureaucrat|WD=Q572700|lt=bureaucrats|1=Bureaucrat}}, especially those with notable contributions during the {{ill|Meiji Restoration|en|Meiji Restoration|WD=Q8707|lt=Meiji Restoration|1=Meiji Restoration}}. Historical figures awarded the posthumous Shōgoi include {{ill|Mamiya Rinzō|en|Mamiya Rinzō|WD=Q952891|lt=Mamiya Rinzō|1=Mamiya Rinzō}} (granted in {{ill|1904|en|1904|WD=Q2046|lt=1904|1=1904}}) and {{ill|Kanezawa Sanetoki|en|Kanezawa Sanetoki|WD=Q596360|lt=Hōjō Sanetoki|1=Kanezawa Sanetoki}} (granted in {{ill|1915|en|1915|WD=Q2084|lt=1915|1=1915}}) for cultural accomplishments like founding the {{ill|Kanazawa Bunko|en|Kanazawa Bunko|WD=Q3192586|lt=Kanazawa Library|1=Kanazawa Bunko}}.

Under the current system, Ranks are conferred posthumously as honors. Recipients often include distinguished {{ill|University|en|University|WD=Q3918|lt=university|1=University}} and {{ill|college|ja|短期大学|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/college|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=Junior colleges in Japan|WD=Q110296306}} professors, {{ill|Business manager|en|Business manager|WD=Q832136|lt=business leaders|1=Business manager}}, {{ill|civil servants|ja|公務員|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/civil servants|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=Civil servant|WD=Q212238}}, and notable {{ill|Scholar|en|Scholar|WD=Q20826540|lt=scholars|1=Scholar}}, {{ill|artists|ja|芸術家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/artists|1=artist|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q847689}}, and {{ill|performers|ja|芸能人|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/performers|1=public entertainer|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q1899943}} who received awards like the {{ill|Order of the Rising Sun, Gold Rays with Neck Ribbon|ja|旭日中綬章|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Order of the Rising Sun, Gold Rays with Neck Ribbon|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 旭日章|1=Order of the Rising Sun|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q818600}}.
